zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis tshogs bdag gzir ba'i mthus/ des bskul nas sa ston ri pa bsams bzhin 'phags pa rin po cher skye ba bzhes nas hor rgyal po'i ti shrī gyur te bod chol kha gsum gyi bdag por dbang bskur ba/ khams su dge slong bzhi sde zhig gis lha chen 'di bsgrubs pas gser lug gi mchin pa tsam rnyed pa sogs thun mong gi dngos grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i gser chos zab mo'i skor la/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i dgongs pa ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi yi ge la brten nas ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/ paṇa chen 'di sngon ma thos kyang slar thos rgyur bris/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i phyag len khrigs chags 'dod dgu'i dpag bsam gyi steng nas dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i ma nor don tshang gsal ba'i sgron me'i steng nas dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i khyad par gyi rjes gnang*/ rje ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i ma nor gsal ba'i sgron me'i steng nas jo bo chen po lugs kyi tshogs bdag dkar po chags pa'i rdo rje'i rjes gnang*/ she'u lo tsā ba'i yi ge'i steng nas jo bo chen po'i lugs kyi tshogs bdag glang gdong dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang rnams legs par nos nas/ rgyab brten lung gi skor la/ rtsa 1 ba'i yi ge gsal 2 byed kyi lhan thabs/ gsang 3 sgrub kyi yi ge zhar 4 byung jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i dkar po/ gser 5 chos kyi gsang sgrub dmar po phyag bzhi pa'i yi ge dkar 6 chag tu ma bzhugs pa'i skor dang drug dang po la/ 'gor 'jig rten dbang phyug la (glo)phyag 'tshal lo tshogs kyi bdag po'i lo rgyus ni zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus/

mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos las dbang phyug gi chung ma phag mo'i bur tshogs bdag skyes pa'i gtam rgyud/ 'gor dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// bgegs kyi rgyal po'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni zhes yod pa'i rjes (glo)gnang gi yig rnying mal los mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi phyag len rgyas bsdus yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa/ 'gor dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// bgegs kyi rgyal po'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i khyad par gyi rjes gnang gi yi ge dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa khyad par gyi gdams pa brjed thor bkod pa'i mtha' can/ yar klungs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi gsal byed bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa bla ma gong ma'i yi ge dang mi mthun pas spang bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal tshogs kyi bdag po zhes yod pa'i thun mong gi rjes (glo)gnang ngor chen gyis mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag gi rjes gnang bya tshul i thi'i mtha' can/ tshogs bdag gi rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u bcu dgu pa las phyung ba'i 'phags pa bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po'i gzungs (glo)lo tsā ba dge slong puṇ+ye shrī bha dras dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ grub chen nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs zhes pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgom bzlas paṇa chen ga ya dha ra dang bla chen 'brog mis bsgyur ba/ yang des mdzad pa'i bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs (glo)ga ya dha ra dang gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba/ des mdzad pa'i 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i bstod pa 'jig rten mgon mdzad ma/ 'di'i gsham du bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyal ba'i phrin las ma dang de nas mu mthud pa'i bzlas pa bya tshul sogs yar klungs pa'i mdzad byang yod pa zhig chos tshan gcig gi tshul du 'dug pa dkar chag na mi gsal yig rgyun ma dag pa 'byams pa las 'og gi yar klungs pa'i gtor chog na mdzad byang sogs mi 'dug pas de'i zhabs yin nam snyam pa slar yang dpe rnyed na dpyad dgos 'dug go

/des mdzad pa'i bgegs kyi rgyal po'i bris sku'i man ngag ga ya dha ra dang gyi jo'i 'gyur/ des mdzad pa'i 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'gyur bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ba/ des mdzad pa'i bgegs bdag gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'gyur gong 'dra/

dkar chag dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar 'dug sbyin sreg gi yi ger 'brog mi'i 'gyur zer ba 'dug pas dpyad/ shin tu myur ba'i lha bgegs chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i las bzhi'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed ḍom+bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ slob dpon nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam par (glo)bshad pa rje btsun rin po che grags pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mjug na zhar byung gi zhal gdams mang po yod kyang ma bris so'i mtha' can/ 'gor rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo ga ṇa pa ti sgrub par byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i gsang sgrub lha dgu'i sgrub (glo)yig rnying pa dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho brtol nas 'ong ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// ga ṇa pa ti sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i gsang sgrub lha dgu'i sgrub thabs sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can zhar byung dam tshig dang 'phags pa rin po che sum cu rtsa gsum du khyer ba'i lo rgyus zur tsam dang bcas pa/ de dang 'dra min 'gor dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// yod pa gsang sgrub drag po'i lag len sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ zhar byung sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro dang sngags byang bstan pa/ tshogs bdag gi mngon rtogs/ gtor 'bul/ bstod pa/ rmi ltas/ sku'i dbang sdud/ 'khor lo'i las sbyor 'dre mthong dang bcas pa rnams zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ dpal ga ṇa pa ti'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum spogs chog dang bcas pa gsal bar ston pa'i sgrub yig chen mo gzhan las ches khyad par 'phags pa stong gsum nor bus bkang ba las kyang dga' ba 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/

'di dus gcig la slob ma gcig las mi ston pa'i gser chos bka' rgya can yin no// des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs khrigs kyi sdom tshig shin tu gsal ba/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo zhes yod pa'i tshogs bdag gi gtor chog (glo)rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pas mdzad pa/ 'di'i mjug rgyal ba'i sku gsung ma zer ba'i bstod pa slob dpon nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad zer ba zhig gis rdzogs pa las yar klungs pa'i mdzad byang ma byung bas gong du dogs slong bris pa'i nag po pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'jig rten mgon mdzad ma'i gsham du drung chos rje pas mdzad zer ba'i bstod pa dang gtor chog sogs kyi mthar yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis dam pa mang po'i bzhugs gnas bsam gling bde chen du sbyar zer ba 'dug pa/ dpe gong 'og gnyis po'i mjug pa'i yig mkhan gyis nor nas bris sam snyam pa slar yang ma dpe rnying pa rnyed na zhu dag gtugs dgos par snang ngo*// gnyis pa gsal byed lhan thabs la/ bris sku bri zhing sgrub pa'i yi ge de phyir sngags la nan tan bya sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ bris sku bri ba'i man ngag rab tu gnas pa dang bcas pa bris sku'i cho ga rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gnod sbyin chen po bse gdong gi gzugs mnan pa'i yig rnying tshigs bcad ma/ gnod sbyin bse gdong can mnan pa'i lag len chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis bsam yas su zin bris mdzad pa/ sku rten bri ba/ dngos grub kyi rten gtor bca' ba/ gsang rten lus la bcang ba/ rgyun gtor gter du sba ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad dbab kyi yig chung bka' rgya can gser chos chig brgyud ma/ sgrub pa'i sgab 'dre gnon pa/ gsang rten bca' ba/ bla rdo 'chang ba/ dngos grub blang thabs rnams ston pa'i gsang ba gnad kyi yig chung sgrub yig chen mo'i lhan thabs bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gser chos chig brgyud ma/

gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i las bzhi sgrub tshul spogs chog gsang ba thugs kyi man ngag nor bu bsam gtan/ tshogs bdag dang tsartsi zhal sbyor gyi thab gter/ bang mdzod kyi cho ga rnams ston pa'i yi ge rin chen ljon shing gser chos chig brgyud gras/ 'gor dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing zhes yod pa'i sbyin sreg gi lag len me ma shi bar gzhan reg tu mi 'jug go'i mtha' can/ bi na ya'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i phyag mtshan bcu gnyis kyi las tshogs (glo)zhes pa dgra s+t+was dgra bo gzhom pa/ gtun shing gis bgegs tshar gcod pa/ mda' gzhus dgra bo dbang du byed pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gas 'byung po dga' bar byed pa/ lcags kyus 'gro ba dbang du bsdu ba/ thod pas gdul bya 'gugs pa/ rdo rjes gdon bgegs tshar gcod pa/ ral gris gza' bsrung ba/ thod pa sha chen gyis nor bsgrub pa/ phub la brten nas gnod pa gang 'dod bsrung ba/ ba dan gyis grags pa spel ba/ mdung gis bsam pa sgrub pa rnams ston pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i (glo)bstod pa tshig rkang bcu bdun ma/ des mdzad pa'i spyan 'dren mchod phreng shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ gi mtha' can/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa paṃ pad raṃ nyi ma/ des mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i phrin las ma/ ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa (glo)gdug pa kun 'dul ma rnams so// gsum pa gsang sgrub kyi yi ge la/ tshogs bdag dmar po gsang sgrub zhal gcig phyag drug pa'i sgrub (glo)pa dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ de'i lag len tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang sgrub kyi lag len rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ ḍom+bi he ru ka nas brgyud pa'i tshogs bdag dmar chung zhal gcig phyag gnyis nor rgyun ma dang yab yum du sgrub pa'i yi ge mchod pa'i las so'i mtha' can/ rgyal blon btsun mo 'bangs sogs dbang du bsdu ba'i yi ge

rten phyi nang gsang gsum bca' ba'i yi ge rdzogs so'i mtha' can zhar byung dbang du ma 'dus na dmigs pa bya tshul dang bcas rnams so// bzhi pa zhar byung jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i dkar po'i skor la/ tshogs bdag rigs lnga ston pa'i rgyud rin chen gter mdzod le'u dgu pa paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ kā ra dang nag tsho lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i 'gyur gegs sel ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ kā ra dang lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng gis yam bu mkhar du bsgyur ba/ de'i lag len 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i gegs sel gyi sgrub thabs jo bo a ti shas mdzad pa gu gul gyis bdug cing gtor ma btang ngo'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa phyag 'tshal dpal ldan ma/ tshogs bdag gi sku la rab gnas bya ba mchod thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gnad la dbab pa rgya brtson 'grus seṅge'i man ngag shin tu zab pa/ gnad la bor ba/ bzlas pa'i zhal gdams sbyin sreg gi las med thabs med pa'i mtha' can/ bsad pa'i las rta phru ma/ spogs pa'i yig chung*/ rjes gnang lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i yi ge yang jo bo rje'i gdams pa tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bzhi pa a mo gha nas brgyud pa'i skor la/ tshogs bdag sgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis zhes 'gor yod pa'i tshogs bdag dkar po glang gdong phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ma mthong bar du'o'i mtha' can paṇ+ḍi ta a dkar dri la dur khrod phung lung nag por skye ba sngon ma'i yon bdag dang phrad pa'i lung bstan byung tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus/ dkar chag na bar 'dir tshogs bdag dkar po sha ba'i gdong can gyi sgrub thabs zer ba zhig 'dug kyang dpe ma 'byor pas lung ma thob/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang sgrub a mo gha badz+ra gyis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na dang lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/

tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub pa'i man ngag nges par dbang du 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ sku la rab gnas bya thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ mnyes par bya ba'i phyir gtor ma 'bul ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bstod pa sum cu rtsa gsum ma a mo gha badz+ra gyis mdzad pa rnams so// lnga pa gser chos kyi gsang sgrub phyag bzhi pa'i yig rnying la/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe 'di la bsod nams che ba zhes 'gor yod pa'i gsang sgrub dmar po phyag bzhi pa'i yig rnying stong grogs gyis shig gi mtha' can/ de'i rten bca' ba sogs kyi zhal gdams dam pa kun dga' grags kyis yi ger bkod pa/ bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa nor gyi rgyur 'gyur ma 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag yang gsang drag po btsan thabs su sgrub pa'i nying khu zab mo phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg spogs chog dang bcas pa bla ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag glang po'i gzugs sgrub thabs kyi sgo nas nor sbyin pa'i zhal gdams zhes pa glang po che'i gzugs la brten nas sgrub pa rje bsam gtan gling pa'i phyag dpe dngos las bshus pa rnams so// sa bcad lnga pa 'di thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na gsum pa'i mjug na mthud pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa'i khyad par gyi gdams pa gser chos thun mong ma yin pa'o zhes yar bcad nas sa bcad bzhi pa 'di logs su mdzad pa don la gnas na'ang*/ 'dir dkar chag chen mo'i bzhugs tshul ltar bkod pa chos sde'i brgyud babs kyi dbye ba ma 'dres par byed dgos shing*/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ ga ya dha ra/ ha ngu dkar po/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs te brgyud pa bzhi'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi dbye ba'ang kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan 'dzin zhig gi zhal lung las len dgos kyi shes rlom kun gyi spyod yul ma yin no// drug pa dkar chag tu ma bzhugs pa'i skor la dpal tshogs kyi bdag po dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len khrigs chags 'dod dgu'i dpag (ngag)bsam paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/

des mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po'i khyad par gyi rjes gnang (ngag)ma nor don tshang gsal ba'i sgron me/ tshogs bdag dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ sdogs pa/ sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad ma bla ma gnyan phul byung bas (chen)mdzad pa sba zhing gsang la sgrub pa'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa dpal (chen)chen spyan snga ma/ dbang du byed na zla (chen)gam dmar po zhes sogs kyi zhal shes/ 'gor gdams pa 'di'i don la gsum ste zhes dang (chen)a kā ro bdun gyis dbul lo'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin bse gdong mnan pa'i gdams (chen)pa sems can kho na'i don du dam tshig go'i mtha' can/ yang 'gor bzlog pa rem du bya zhes yod pa'i bse gdong mnan pa (chen)lus nag sna dmar gzugs su 'dri'i mtha' can/ dang po tshogs bdag gi phyi nas 'brangs zhes 'gor yod pa'i bse gdong mnan (chen)pa smon lam 'debs su 'jug go'i mtha' can/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rin chen spungs (klong)pa zhes pa snyan ngag mkhan dpal ldan bsam yas pa'am klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bstod (klong)pa sdeb sbyor rgya mtsho'i sprin/ mgon po tshogs kyi bdag po mchod cing sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub kyi 'byung (mi)gnas paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ mchod gtor 'bul zhing phrin las 'chol (chen)ba tshar gyis mdzad pa phun tshogs dngos grub ma/ tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub thabs (nā)slob dpon nā ro pas mdzad pa gsang ba'i man ngag chags pa rdo rje'i skor nas rgyud kyi bsdus don rnam par bshad pa'o'i mtha' can/ tshogs bdag khro bo spre'u ltar sgrub pa bla ma gser gling pas mdzad pa/ spre'u ltar sgrub pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang sgrub dpal a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i zab pa/ tshogs bdag gi gtor ma sa māp+ta'i mtha' can/ gsol gdab mi 'gyur bkod pa zhar byung spyan 'dren ri rab ma dang bcas pa/

chags pa rdo rje'i zhal gdams tshigs gnyis ma/ sngags 'bum gyi gdams pa ga ṇa pa ti spre'u'i sgrub thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ tshogs bdag gsang sgrub ces pa bsnyen pa bla rdo gnad dbab dang bcas pa ga lnga mar grags pa bla ma'i zhal las rnyed pa'i gdams pa/ 'gor sngags gzhan gnyis po 'di gong ma gtsigs che zhes yod pa'i spre'u'i zhal gdams bsam gtan gling pas mdzad pa thugs dam ma nyams pa'o'i mtha' can/ a mo ghas mdzad pa'i skor la/ la du 'chos thabs/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di'i 'og tu gcun sngags zer ba logs su ma rnyed/ zan nam chan la gtor ma bre gang yan chad bzang bar byas te zhes pa 'gor yod pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ tshogs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'di sgrub par 'dod pas zhes 'gor yod pa'i sgrub thabs dbu shar du blta ba yin gsungs pa'i mtha' can/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po'i gzungs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gor yod pa'i bstod pa zhes su gsol gyi mtha' can/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor longs spyod brtag dka' ba zhes 'gor yod pa'i sgrub thabs thob par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ mig mthong gi gdams pa rnams so// dpe ris skor la/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ dmar chen dang dmar chung gi gtor dpe/ bse gdong can gyi ling ga ga brgyad 'khor lo/ 'di la 'phags pa'i sku srung dang gong ma'i yig rnying gi lugs srol gnyis tsam yod/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo las bzhi sgrub pa'i gnam sa bar gsum gyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis/ tshar chen gyi sku srung la rgyas pa'i steng 'khor gyi yi ge ma log pa dang 'jam dbyangs chen po'i sku srung la drag po'i steng 'khor yi ge log pa sogs gong ma'i gsung rgyun sku srung sogs kyi zab gnad mang bar snang ngo*// rgyas pa'i bar 'khor gyi lte bar 'dri rgyu'i nor bu mig gsum/

thab gter gyi dngos grub myur du blang 'khor/ tshogs bdag dang tsartsi ka zhal sbyor gyi thab dang mdzod kyi 'khor lo rnams kyi dbang lung phyag len man ngag legs par nos pa las/ thog mar ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub chen sha wa ri pa/ ha ngu dkar po/ gsan yig gong ma rnams na hūm̐ ka ra zhes snang*/ mal lo blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa dang thar rtse ba dang sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa rnams kyi gsan yig na 'di ltar yod kyi/ mkhyen brtse dang rgyal dbang lnga pa rmor pa rnams kyi gsan yig na sa paṇa dang 'di'i bar na 'gro mgon 'phags pa yod pa'ang byung*/ rin po che skyob pa dpal bzang po/ rong pa shes rab seṅge/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi gsan yig na bar 'dir bla ma ngag dbang zhes pa zhig byung ngo*// mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje lha mchog seṅge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge/ paṇ+ḍi ta nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ brang ti nam mkha' rin chen/ se chen gan nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'dren mchog shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ shar pa blo gros grags pa/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ba chen po bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la lan gnyis su bka' drin du stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/

rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la lan mang du stsal to// yang na 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ bka' drin gzhal med rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ba chen po dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngor chen nas/ gung ru shes rab bzang po/ mkhyen rab chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba byang chub rab tshes zla ba/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ de dbon mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ de dbon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man 'dra/ e rtags can gyi brgyud tshul yang 'di nyid do// rjes gnang thun mong ba'i brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ nyi lde ba ngag dbang grags pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ de gnyis ka las sgo rum pa/ de gnyis ka las tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras gnyis ka las rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ grub mchog bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ grub dbang ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/

shar phyogs nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū tī pa/ ga ya dhā ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seṅge bzang po/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog bdag chen 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje gzhon nu stobs ldan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man gong dang 'dra/ yang na tshar chen yab sras las/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kas gsan/ gnyis ka nas rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ tshogs bdag gi khyad par ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan yan gong ltar las/ de nas mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ khams sgom byang chub dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ ti shrī kun dga' blo gros/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ de gnyis ka las bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de nas yar klungs pa man 'dra/ yang na dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin rgyal/ 'bri phyug pa rin chen 'bum/ yar klungs pa man 'dra/ yang rtsa ba'i yi ge dang*/ gsal byed lhan thabs kyi yi ge dang*/ gsang sgrub skor nas ḍo'i rtags can rnams kyi brgyud pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra/ yang na mkhyen brtse'i zhabs nas sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/

rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis man sngar dang 'dra/ ngag rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ 'khon sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam pa'i rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug de sras ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen pa man 'dra/ klong rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ pha rgod rtogs ldan rgyal po/ drin chen thugs sras chos rje/ sprul sku rdo rje seṅge/ bka' bcu pa puṇ+ya singha/ rje blo gros seṅge/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra'o// maṃ gyi rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ dpal ldan rgyal mtshan rje phrin las pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ glo'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ gong ngor lugs rjes gnang gi thun mong ma yin pa dang 'dra/ nā ro pa'i gsang sgrub dang nā'i rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ mal lo/ sa skya pa chen po man 'dra/ sa dpyad gsum pa ḍom+bi lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ḍom+bi pa/ dzñā na pañdza/ kṛṣ+ṇa pa/ bhi na su ka dharma sidha/ su kha pa ti/ rdo rje gdan pa/ khro phu lo chen/ sangs rgyas zhig po/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma 'ban ston/ bla ma rdo rje seṅge/ bka' bcu pa bsod nams seṅge/ bla ma blo gros seṅge/ rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra/ tshogs bdag chags pa rdo rje'i rjes gnang dang*/ sa bcad bzhi pa dang drug pa'i chos skor gyi lung brgyud ni/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ rgyal po grags pa/ bo dhi a ka ra/ rin chen 'od zer/ yang dag sbyin pa/ rat+na a ka ra shān+ti/ jo bo chen po a ti sha lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seṅge/ grub thob shol po ba/

sangs rgyas dbon ston/ sangs rgyas ston tshul/ khyung tshang pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ snar thang mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dbu ma pa grub pa brtson 'grus/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seṅge/ gung chen pa bkra shis bzang po/ gnyags phu ba bsod nams bzang po/

rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na tshal min chos rje zer/ seṅge dbal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ 'di rmor chen pa'i gsan yig na ma byung yang*/ lnga pa chen po'i gsan yig na chos rje klu dbang gling pa zhes byung*/ tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man 'dra/ sa bcad bzhi pa dang*/ sa bcad drug pa'i a mo gha nas brgyud pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ a mo gha badz+ra/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ lam yig sogs su jo bos nā ro par phyag mi mdzad pas chos 'brel med pa 'dra zhes zer yang bka' gdams glegs bam du brgyud pa'i khrod du bgrang yod pa 'di dang mthun no// jo bo dī paṃ ka ra/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ bya 'chang kha ba/ khra phu ba/ khyi lo yo ga shī la pra bha wa/ dol ku mā ra/ lcan ban+de/ gsal ba sgang pa/ slob dpon dpal mgon/ slob dpon bde ba/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na slob dpon 'od ma zhes snang ngo*// gnyags dbon rin chen man 'dra/ yang na a mo gha badz+ra/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma byang chen pa/ bka' bcu pa gzhon seng man 'dra/ tshogs bdag phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ gzhon nu seṅge yan gong ltar las/ de nas srib ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ lhang phug pa rin chen 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan grub pa/ rin po che sangs rgyas 'od zer/ gtsang pa blo bzang pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga bsod nams chos grags rgyal mtshan/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/

des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// sa bcad lnga pa gsang sgrub gser chos kyi lung brgyud ni yar klungs pa khu dbon nas/ bla ma dge bzang pa/ dung gzims khang dbon po/ rje rat+na bha dra/ tshar pa rdo rje 'chang man 'dra'o// rtags yod med la ma ltos pa tshogs bdag gi chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi lung ni/ mkhyen brtse yan gong tshar chen brgyud par bzhugs so cog ltar las/ de nas bar bar/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud/ pad+ma he ru ka'i dbang du bsdu ba'i le'u sogs nas bstan pa'i khro bo kag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i chos skor ni/ dkar chag las/ gsang ba'i snying po ā li kā li'i bcud// gsang sngags 'dzin pa gzhan la ma grags pa'i// gsang chen chos kyi bdag po sa skya pa'i// gsang ba'i gdams pa zab mo 'di ltar snang*// zhes dang*/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ gdams pa 'di dag thub pa'i bstan pa dang*// khyad par sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa'i ched// nyams su blangs na yid ches 'phel du 'byung*// zhes bsngags par mdzad pa don dang mthun pas bla ma ba ri bas mnga' bdag rtse lde sogs rgya bod mang po dbang du bsdus/ bal por bod thang zhes bya'i sa gzhi chen po gser dpag med kyi rin gyis nyos/ brtse ba chen po la 'phrang brag dmar gyi sde mgon gyis sku dgra byas pa 'di'i sgo nas dbang du bsdus/ gshen rdor seng gis dpal phag mo grub pa dbang du mdzad/ do pa ston tshul ngom shod rje btsad kun gyi bla mar gyur/ rgyal tsha lung mang po hor rgyal po'i ti shrīr bskur ba sogs ngo mtshar lo rgyus nges shes can gyi man ngag skor la/ sa paṇa gyi yi ge dang dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/

mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang legs par nos nas/ rgyab brten lung la/ thun mong ba/ thun mong ma yin pa/ dkar chag tu ma bzhugs pa'i skor dang gsum/ dang po la 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams ngag 'di'i brgyud pa ni zhes yod pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus rong pa dge ring gis zhus pa'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor pad+ma dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa'i dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo yang sdud thugs kyi 'khor lo byung tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus cung zad rgyas par phye ba thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa chos kyi rjes gsungs pa'o'i mtha' can/ dbang sdud kag chol ma'i lung gi rjes gnang gi cho ga (glo)dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rgyas par bkod pa/ byin rlabs kyi lung blang ba'i zhal shes sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i man ngag zab mo/ bla ma sa skya pa'i gdams pa (glo)nam mkha' mdzod kyi rjes gnang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gro ge ma'i sgrub ka kha ma'i sgrub thabs kyang zer thabs kyi rjes gnang bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin sngags 'chang rgyal ba dpal gyis sa skya'i sku 'bum gyi gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ sngags kyi rgyal po'i dam tshig gi dngos grub mchog sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub (glo)thabs slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po de bzhin gshegs pa bsrungs pa'i dpal gyi zhal snga nas dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis bsgyur ba/ gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor lo snod bcud dbang du bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta s+tha bī ra'i zhal snga nas dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs (glo)dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag ba ri bas bsgyur ba/

khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i man ngag rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ phrin las bzhi'i sgrub thabs kyi don yang dag par bsdus pa rgya sgom tshul khrims grags kyis mdzad pa/ slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gsal bar byed pa'i 'grel (glo)pa rin po che'i myu gu rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ 'gor zhi ba la kha dog dkar po zhes yod pa'i phrin las bzhi'i man ngag zhi rgyas dbang drag thams cad de dang 'dra bar go bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'dir 'khor lo rab tu gnas pa byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i las bzhi 'khor lo'i rab gnas so so'i skabs dang sbyar bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ bsnyen pa/ 'khor lo/ dngos gzhi/ tsakra sgrub pa/ rjes spogs pa/ gnad kyi man ngag dngos grub dam tshig ste spyi don rnam pa dgus bstan pa'i spyi'i man ngag mdor bstan zhes bya ba dbang gi phrin las kyi lag len mngon rtogs smar khrid du dge slong shī la kīrtis bkod pa/ rgya sgom tshul khrims grags/ 'gor khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ wa shaṃ ku ru ho yod pa'i dbang sdud kag chol gyi sgrub thabs rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa 'dzam gling gser gyis bkang ba bas kyang 'di mi dga' ri shi'i mtha' can/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge ba ri lo tsā ba'i gser chos rje sa skya pa'i zhal gdams thun mong ma yin pa/ gor rnal 'byor pa sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i dus su zhes pa'i bzlas pa'i zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i gsung me spel gsang ba'i bka' rgyas btab pa'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dbyangs yig dang zhes pa'i dbang gi gtor ma'i man ngag (glo)dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i phyag bzhes so'i mtha' can/ dbang gi 'khor lo'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdams pa/ 'gor thun bzhi la nyer spyod kyi mchod pa byed na zhes yod pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba'i rim pa'o'i mtha' can/

sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rab dga' zla rgyas ma/ 'gor sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo dpe'u chung ltar bris la zhes yod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa dang 'khor lo'i nang tshan bstan pa bla ma ba ri ba'i gdams ngag gnad khyad par du 'phags pa/ sgom pa'i dus kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i gdams ngag shin tu zab pa gzhan la gsang bar zhu'i mtha' can/ sngags byang 'byin 'jug dang bzlas thabs bla ma'i zhal shes so'i mtha' can/ gnad kyi sgrub thabs snying dang 'dra ba/ 'gor oṃ shīn+taṃ ka ra ṇi bh+rūm̐ yod pa'i sngags dang 'khor lo'i gnad lung 'bogs pa rā dza la sogs pa dbang du bya ba'i yig chung gzhan rnams gong dang mthun no'i mtha' can/ bri gzhi sogs lnga/ maṇ+ḍal sogs lnga/ snod sogs brgyad de man ngag gi bsdus don nyung ngu mchan bu dang bcas pa/ 'gor bsnyen pa 'dod rgyal la 'bum phrag nyer bzhi bskyal la zhes yod pa'i ka kha 'khor lo brtsegs rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba la mi phyed pa/ dbang du 'gyur ba/ 'ong ba bcings pa bzhin 'gyur ba/ 'gugs pa/ nor rgyas pa/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa/ rig byed mas 'gugs pa/ bu mo dbang du byed pa/ gnod sbyin mo'i nor 'gugs pa/ thams cad dbang du byed pa/ bran du 'gyur ba/ 'bru 'phel ba/ bang mdzod mi zad pa/ sngar ma mthong ba'i bud med dang*/ rgyal po'i btsun mo 'gugs pa/ bltas pa/ byin pa/ brgyab pa/ reg pas dbang du 'gyur ba/ mi 'bral ba/ rgyal po dbang du bya ba/ ḍā ki thams cad 'ong ba la sogs las phran tshegs bstan pa'i skor/ dbang gi sbyin sreg gi lag len bla ma chen po sa skya pa'i phyag bzhes/ sku gsung thugs kyi rab gnas kyi zhal gdams zin bris/ tsakra'i rab gnas bya thabs ba ri lo tsā ba'i man ngag bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge bsdus pa bar gcod mi 'byung zhing las myur ba yin gsungs pa'i mtha' can/

ḍā ki ma'i 'gro ba dbang sdud kyi gdams pa zhes pa dbang drag gi man ngag zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo bud+dhā a mo gha sid+dhi zhes yod pa'i 'khor los bsgrub bya dgug pa sogs ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdams pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhal gdams bod du thon pa'i man ngag la 'di las zab pa med do'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo'i yi ge la gtor ma 'bul ba'i zhal gdams bla ma (glo)sa skya pa chen po'i phyag bzhes/ gnod sbyin rin chen sgrub pa'i u pa de sha 'gor wa shaṃ ku ru ho gro ga mdzub gang pa gcig la zhes pa'i 'khor lo'i man ngag gsung tshad ma gru bzhir bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor gro ga mdzub gang la nang du sor bdun tsam zhes pa'i 'khor lo bri thabs sba ba'i man ngag bzla tshe sbrel nas bzla zhes pa'i mtha' can/ dbang gi tsakra'i zhal gdams nam mkha' mdzod kyi gdams pa nyung ngu la 'dus pa khyad par du 'phags so'i mtha' can/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gnad bod du 'gyur ba'i gdams pa zab pa nus pa chung ngu mi 'gro ba'i gnad yin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor yar gyi tshes brgyad la rjes gnang zhu'o zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams zin bris ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub bo rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ ḍā ki ma'i gdams pa rdzun mi smra'o'i mtha' can/ ḍā ki ma'i srog snying khong nas phyung ba ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdams pa chig brgyud/ bla ma ba ri bas sag thang pa dang dol po bsod nams 'phel la gnang ba'i ḍā ki ma sgrub pa'i lag len zhes pa 'khor lo/ bzlas sgom mchod gtor/ lag len ga'u gzhung dang mthun zhes pa rnams bstan pa/ rtags kyi yi ge (glo)ba ri lo tsā ba bod du 'byon khar bla ma rdo rje gdan pas gnang ba/ gzhan dbang du byed pa'i gdams pa rin po che'i zhal gdams mthar thug pa/ tshe bsring ba'i thabs/ de'i zhal shes pad+ma kha sbyor gyi ting 'dzin/ rgyas pa'i gtor ma'i phyag bzhes dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i khyad par gyi man ngag

drag po'i phrin las sgrub par 'dod pas 'grub nas dben par sba'o'i mtha' can/ bla ma la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas lung 'bogs pa'i gdams pa/ chu dang phyag rgya'i nyin srung mtshan srung gi man ngag de'i yi ge mchan bu dang bcas pa bar du gcod pa rnams srungs shig gi mtha' can rnams te/ man ngag 'di'i mjug tu bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sa skya pa'i// dbang sdud man ngag khyad par can// snyan brgyud zhal gdams ma gtogs pa// thun mong chos skor tshang bar bzhugs// snod ldan slob ma 'ga' tsam las// gzhan la rgya cher spel mi bya// rdo rje lta bur rtogs dka' zhing*// rtogs na yid bzhin nor 'dra'i chos// des na 'di lta'i zab don la// mkhas pas gces spras bya bar rigs// zhes gsungs pa ltar shin tu zab cing dkon pa'i chos 'di snying gi thig ler 'chang ba'i 'os so// ༈ //gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la/ khams gsum 'gro ba dbang byed kag chol gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus (glo)mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa/ dbang sdud kag chol ma'i ā li kā li'i sngags ring 'dri bzlas kyi (glo)man ngag sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas dag cing gsal bar mdzad pa/ kag chol chen mo'i rtsa ba'i tho yig brjed byang tsam du sh+r+yā nan+da gar+bhas dpal kun dga' snying po/ mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i de'i 'grel ṭīka sbas pa'i mig 'byed gser gyi thur ma/ 'khor lo'i rab gnas bya ba'i man (glo)ngag zhal gdams dang bcas pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rgyas par bkod pa/ des bkod pa'i bde ba rgyas byed ma'i sku (glo)la brten pa'i dbang gi nang sgrub zab mo/ gsang sgrub tha chen gyi tsakra'i man (glo)ngag rje btsun rin po che grags pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i gnad 'bebs (glo)nyi zla'i 'khor lo'i gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i spogs chog gis gnad la dbab (glo)pa'i man ngag sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rgyas par bkod pa/

des mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i man ngag (glo)bla ma'i zhal las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ yul bdag dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal gdams ba ri'i man ngan rje sa skya pa'i gdams pa/ 'gor bzlas pa'i sngags kyi man ngag ni zhes yod pa'i sngags kyi 'byin 'jug gi yi ge las de bzhin du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro'i mtha' can/ gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor lo'i bsdus don rang bsrung ngo'i mtha' can/ ma grub na spogs pa'i cho ga mnyam par bzhed do'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo bltab tshigs kyi zhal gdams smin mtshams su reg pa'o'i mtha' can/ ma grub na gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo gces par zung gi mtha' can/ 'gor kho bo'i bla ma 'di skad gsung zhes pa yod pa'i pho mo gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo/ 'gor phyi sgrub 'khor lo chen mo zhes pa'i gnad 'bebs nyi zla'i gdams pa/ 'gor bla ma'i zhal gdams 'dri bar bya zhes pa yod pa'i pho mo gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo'i zhal gdams sa skya pa chen po'i zhal gyi gdams pa ma bu 'di rnams bris pa legs kyi mtha' can/ 'gor dngos grub kyi mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes yod pa'i tha chen 'khor lo'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs the tshom med do'i mtha' can/ de'i zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i gdams ngag nor bu rin po che phag mo grub pa la gnang ba/ tha chen 'khor lo'i yi ge dbang sdud dam pa/ 'gor bla ma bde chen lhag pa'i lha zhes yod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i rdzas sgrub gshen bde ba'i rdo rjes bla ma sa skya pa chen por zhus pa khyad par gnad kyi gdams pa'o'i mtha' can/ de'i gsal byed 'gor mkha' 'gro bde ba rgyas byed kyi sku zhes yod pa'i zhang btsun sag thang ba'i zhal gdams/ phrin las myur du sgrub pa dbang gi rlung 'khor zab mo (glo)dang rlung lha las la gzhug pa sogs gab pa'i man ngag sa skya pa'i zhal gdams/ 'gor dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang zhes yod pa'i a'i gdams pa zur gcig 'dri ba ā li gnad kyi gdams pa rin chen yid bzhin nor bu bla ma'i bka' rgya can/

de'i zhal shes 'gor spyir ni khams gsum sems can thams cad la zhes yod pa dbang gi gdams pa'i mtha' can/ ā li'i sbyin sreg gshen gyi lugs/ rje sa chen dang 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa gnyis kyis zhu ba (glo)zhus lan ā li kā li las sna tshogs la 'jug pa zhes pa'i gdams pa le'u nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ 'dod rgyal yab yum sbags te sgrub pa'i man ngag lag len du dril ba'i nag po 'gro shes bshes gnyen gra bo rin chen phan gyi don du sngags 'chang rgyal po dpal gyis mdzad pa/ de'i zhal shes de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sa skya pa'i gdams pa khyad par 'phags pa 'dzam gling gser gyis bkang ba las ches cher dga' ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi zur 'debs 'jam dbyangs mgon pos mdzad pa/ dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel (glo)pa 'gro ba'i srog snying 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ khyad par gyi sgrub thabs nor bu gsal 'bar snying gi thig le'i dwangs ma drung nam mkha' bzang pos bskul nas rin po che bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi gsung las skyes pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa ri khro dbang pos bsam gtan gling du mdzad pa/

mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pa'i gsan yig na bsam gtan gling pa dpal ldan bzang pos mdzad ces snang*/ 'di gser chos shin tu zab pa'i chig brgyud dus gcig la slob ma gcig las mi ston pa'i bka' rgya can yin te/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las/ snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa 'di// snod ldan slob ma gcig la ni// bstan par bya yis gzhan du min// gsang ste nyams su blang bar rigs// zhes pa ltar sa bcad gnyis pa 'di bka' dog par mdzad pa'i rgyun ma nyams par yid kyi dran gsor bstan par rigs so// gsum pa dkar chag tu ma bzhugs pa la/ dbang sdud 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud 'debs pad+ma rā ga'i chun po tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ 'gor rtsa ba'i 'khor lo 'di la zhes pa'i 'khor lo'i bri yig zin bris gsang ba ni gcig la yin na'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i bsnyen pa byed par 'dod pas zhes pa'i 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa gtor ma bya khyi dang mi gzhan la mi sbyin no'i mtha' can/ byin rlabs kyi lung blang ba'i gsal byed tsha rong pa rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ 'dod rgyal yab yum gyi rjes gnang gces spras su mdzad pa rje (ngag)dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung las mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis zin thor btab pa/ des mdzad pa'i gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang bklag chog tu bkod pa (ngag)zhar byung thun mong gi rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ nyi zla 'khor lo'i rig pa ban+de bsam gtan gling pas gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis mdzad pa rnams so/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na bsam gtan gling pa phyi ma zhes snang ba nor bu gsal 'bar mdzad mkhan dang gcig gam snyam/ /dpe ris skor la/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal mi 'dra ba gsum/ rab gnas kyi maṇ+ḍal mi 'dra ba gsum/ gtor ma'i maṇ+ḍal zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phyi sgrub kyi 'khor lo bzhi/

drag po'i 'khor lo 'dra min gnyis/ yang sa chen gyi bzhed pa dang mthun pa gcig las bzhi sgrub pa'i 'khor lo kha sbyor bzhi/ sbas pa mig 'byed nas gsungs pa'i rgyas pa'i 'khor lo/ pho mo gnad kyi 'khor lo bzhi yod pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i gsung dang mthun pa dang po/ phag gru'i bzhed pa dang mthun pa gnyis pa/ dpe ris rnying pa kho na la thugs gtsigs su mdzad pa gsum pa/ gsum pa'i mu khyud kyi sngags dum bu gsum du byas pa bzhi pa/ gnad 'bebs nyi zla'i 'khor lo rigs mi gcig pa gsum/ dril sgrub la dgos pa'i tha chen 'khor lo/ gsang sgrub tha chen 'khor lo/ nang sgrub yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi 'khor lo re/ rlung 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang lung man ngag phyag len dmar khrid du thob pa las/ ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang ngam/ dpal mchog rdo rje chos/ ḍā ki bde ba rgyas byed ma/ grub chen dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ thar rtse ba sogs ngor pa'i gsan yig rnams su rdo rje gdan pa/ s+tha bī ra zhes pa las che chung gnyis ma bshad do/ rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ s+tha bī ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ lcags thang pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ rgyal dbang dang rmor chen pa sogs kyi gsan yig tu 'dir slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo zhes byung zhing ngor pa'i gsan yig rnams su ma byung ba brtag byar bzhag rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ khang ston bsod nams 'bum/ bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ bla ma byang chub seṅge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug

'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje lha mchog seṅge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ brang ti nam mkha' rin chen/ se chen gan nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'dren mchog pradzñā sā ga ra/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ba chen po bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la lan zung gi bar du bka' drin du stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la lan mang du stsal to// yang na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ khang ston bsod nams 'bum/ gzhon nu tshul khrims/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ rtags yod med la ma ltos pa'i lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ mkhas grub do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ rin chen seṅge bzang po/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ dpon mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ yab rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras gnyis ka nas rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' pa bsod nams dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na rdo ring pa chen po nas/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ tshar pa rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen yab sras gnyis nas/

mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen brtse'i zhabs nas/ drang srong ka bzhi pa'i sras gzhon nu stobs ldan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ yang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje mkhyen brtse nas/ mkhas pa gzhon nu stobs ldan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man sngar dang 'dra'o// ba ri bas sag thang par gsan pa'i chos skor ni/ jo btsun sag thang pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun lcags thang pa/ gsan yig gad+gā'i chu rgyun du bar 'dir se chung ba zhes pa dang 'ga' zhig tu lcags thang pa med par de'i tshab tu se chung ba zhes pa byung ngo*// sa skya pa chen po man 'dra/ ngag rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang bsod nams chos 'phel dang rje dbang rab gnyis nas mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ 'khon ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'khon ston bsod nams dbang phyug 'khon ston ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang rjes gnang thun mong ba dang glo'i rtags can rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ kun spangs rje nas/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas bla ma gzhon nu 'bum/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ bdag chen gzhi thog pa kun dga' dbang phyug bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ khang ston bsod nams 'bum/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/

de'i gcung rdo rje 'od zer/ 'dul 'dzin bsod nams ye shes/ bla ma bsod nams dar/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ chu mig bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug paṇa chen shāka mchog brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ mkhan chen bkras rnam pa/ rje grol mchog man 'dra'o// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos dzam dmar srog sgrub kyi skor la/ yig rnying rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa'i mchan ma dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i lhan thabs ltar sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du gnod sbyin dmar po yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bzlas pa dam bca'i lung dang gtor dbang dod kyi chu sbyin dang bcas pa nos nas/ lung la gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge la nang gses kyi rten bca' ba/ bsnyen sgrub/ las la bskul ba dang bcas pa bla ma chen pos ma sbas par dpal kha gdangs su yi ger bkod pa sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ lung blang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i gsung bzhin dpal sa skyar sbyar ba/ 'di yan gyi mchan rnams rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pas mdzad la/ dam bca' ba'i mchan bu rdo rje gdan pas mdzad do/ /rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi gsal byed/ grwa pa dang gser chos kyi dzam dmar gnyis kyi rjes gnang lhan cig pa'i phyag len gzhan rnams dkyus kyi yi ge bzhin no'i mtha' can dang bcas pa'i lung legs par thob nas/ rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ grub dbang shar phyogs nag po pa/ rgyal rigs ḍā ma ru pa/ gnyis spangs a wa dhū tī pa/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar/

rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ mkhas grub do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seṅge bzang po/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ dpal kun bzang rtse pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ thar rtse paṇa chen/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ des bdag la'o// yang na rmor chen pa nas/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ rje blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tshar pa rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ yab sras gnyis ka nas rdo rje 'chang dbang rab pa/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na rje shar khang pa nas/ rje shākya 'od zer/ she'u lo tsā ba man 'dra/ yang na shākya 'od zer nas thar rtse paṇa chen man 'dra'o// rmor chen pas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas bdag gis nos so// smras pa/ pad+ma rā ga'i lhun por nyi gzhon gyis// lan brgyar dkris lta'i 'od 'bar rigs byed ma// tshogs bdag 'dod pa'i rgyal po rmugs 'dzin bcas// khams gsum dbang sdud gdams pa mnos tshul lo// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ gser chos dmar po skor gsum dang rmugs 'dzin dmar po srog sgrub bcas pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste nyer gsum pa'o//

༈ //phyi rol yul du snang ba'i dregs pa gsum// nang du rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa khams gsum// gsang bar sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug gsum// dbyer med srid zhi'i mgon po'i chos kyi skor// de'ang 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgyu 'phrul rol pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon char chos skyong ba'i srung ma grangs med pa zhig bka' babs pa'i nang nas rgya gar ma ga dhā'i rdo rje gdan gyi sgo skyong 'phags yul paṇa grub rnams kyi srung ma'i gtso bo rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po ni/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos nag po chen po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i sprul par bstan pas phyogs re tsam gyi sprul pa'i bstan srung gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo ste/ tshul de la dgongs nas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis/ bgrang yas bstan srung kun gyi sde dpon che// dran pas snying gi mun sel rdo rje gur// zhes ched du brjod pa'ang sgro skur gyis dben pa'i rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho na ste/ de'ang dpal kye rdo rje'i bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur/ mgon po mngon par 'byung ba/ lha mo'i khungs 'phags yul na bzhugs pa'i gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa la sogs pa rnams las gsal bar bstan/ bka' lung gi 'grel byed dam pa 'phags pa'i yul du grub pa mchog gi sa la bzhugs pa'i slob dpon bram ze mchog sred la sogs pas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang don yod rdo rje dang shrad+dhā ka ra warma dang shākya shrī rnams las brgyud de byon pa 'jam dpal rdo rje rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyis ches cher gsal bar mdzad de/

ma hā kā la'i chos skor gyi brjed byang bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba las/ khyab bdag gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor ni// 'phags pa'i yul du paṇa grub rnams kyis phye// rgyud rgyal ma dros chu gter las byung ba'i// bka' babs rnam bzhi'i gdams pa'i chu rgyun ni// lo tsā rnam bzhi'i gsung gi 'bab stegs las// legs 'ongs sa skya'i bla chen thugs mtshor 'khyil// gang de'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i zegs ma ni// phyogs brgyar 'phros pas kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir// zab ston lbu phreng bye bas phyug pa yi// rjes 'brangs chu klung rnam bzhi ring du babs// zhes pa ltar rgyud rgyal rnams kyi gdams pa'i snying po 'phags yul paṇa grub rnams kyis srol rgyas bsdus sna tshogs su btod pa'i nang nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i gdams pa lo chen 'brog mis bsgyur ba dang*/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa las brgyud pa sgrub thabs kun las btus pa lugs kyi mgon po'i gdams pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta dad byed go cha las brgyud pa'i mgon po'i gdams pa lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur ba mal lo tsā ba'i lugs su grags pa dang*/ kaṣ+mi ra'i bsod snyoms pa chen po paṇa chen shākya shrī las brgyud pa'i mgon po'i gdams pa sa lo tsā ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba ste lo paṇa chen po bzhi las brgyud pa'i bka' ma chad pa chu bo chen po bzhi'i rgyun ltar babs pa'o// gyi ljang lugs ni lo chen rin bzang nas mal lor brgyud pa yin na'ang*/ stod lugs smad lugs gnyis su byung ba'i stod lugs rnams mal lo nas brgyud pa yin pas bka' babs phyi ma'i khongs su don gyis 'du zhing*/ lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang lo chen nas brgyud pa dang gyi ljang smad lugs kyi gdams skor rnams rje btsun gong ma rnams las ma brgyud na'ang*/

gzhi thog pa sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba nas sa lugs su bka' babs pas deng sang man ngag rnams phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa yin no// de la bka' babs bzhi'i gdams pa rjes 'brang gi mkhas grub ngor pa dang rdzong pa dang gong dkar ba las brgyud pa dang*/ kha'u brag rdzong pa las brgyud pa'i lugs srol gnyis las/ phyi ma'i nang du gong ma gsum yang 'dus par bzhed pa'ang lugs srol 'di nyid kyi phyogs la sku drin gzhal du ma mchis pa'i snyan brgyud bstan pa'i srog zung sa chen por gyur pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ khyad par nag po chen po'i man ngag ni// brgyud ldan bla ma bcu phrag gcig la zhus// 'gran zla kun bral drin can rdo ring pa'i// snyan brgyud zab mo bum pa gang byor thob// e waṃ pa ni bsdus la spros pa chung*// mus srad pa ni dkar chag khrigs chags can// rdo rje gdan pa 'cham dang nus pa'i bdag /kho bos thob pa'i thun mong brgyud pa gsum// zhes snga ma gsum po thun mong bar bzhed cing de dag kyang thun mong ma yin pa rin chen sgang pa sgos kyi zhal ngo nang brgyud snyan brgyud 'dir 'dus pa yin no zhes bzhed do// gang ltar yang 'di nyid ji ltar 'chad par byed pa la snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi tshul du 'chad de/ spyir gsang chen gdams pa'i chos skor snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'i lugs ltar na khog 'bubs lo rgyus rnams ni bla ma tshad ma/ nyams khrid dang mngon spyod drag po'i las sbyor sogs phyag len dmar khrid du bstar pa ni nyams myong tshad ma/ rgyab brten gyi man ngag be bum rnams ni bstan bcos tshad ma/ bshad khungs kyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung rnams ni lung tshad mar yang 'gyur la/ gtso bor snyan brgyud bzhi dang sbyor dgos pas/ de ni byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra ba'i bka' ma nub pa/ gdams ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i sarga ma log pa/

mos gus gzhon nu'i dga' ba lta bu'i bsam pa tshim pa/ bsnyen bkur lha 'dod yon la longs spyod pa lta bu'i dpal 'byor gyi rgyun ma nyams pa ste bzhi'am/ 'ga' zhig tu byin rlabs kyi sgo dbye ba'i rten 'brel dang por bsgrigs pa'i ched du snyan brgyud bzhi pa dang por byas pa'i go rim yod pa dang*/ yang na bla ma snga phyi mang po'i gsung sgros su snyan brgyud gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis go rim log par bshad pa'i tshul yang yod de/ 'di ltar snyan brgyud dang

rdo rje slob dpon la ltos pa'i sngon 'gro'i snyan brgyud/ po dbang dang rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi bka' chu bo'i rgyun ma nub par bskur ba thob pa'o// snyan brgyud gnyis rdo rje slob dpon la ltos pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyan brgyud/ pa man ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang 'dra ba gdams pa'i sarga ma log par thob pa'o// snyan brgyud gsum pa snyan brgyud kyi rgyu la snyan brgyud kyi ming btags/ rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po'i lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyi sgo nas mnyes par byas pa las snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo thob par 'gyur ba ste/ rje sa skya pa chen pos bla ma mal lo tsā ba la gser srang bcu bdun dus gcig tu phul bas gdams pa ma lus pa thob pa lta bu'o// snyan brgyud bzhi snyan brgyud kyi 'bras bu la ming btags/ pa mos gus gzhon nu'i bde ba lta bu shugs las 'byung ba'i go rim mi 'dra bar snang na'ang 'chad tshul gyi khyad par cung zad las don gyi cha la khyad par med pa yin la/ de ltar snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas 'chad dgos pa/ thog mar byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra ba'i bka' ma nub pa la dbang dang rjes gnang gnyis/ dang po dbang gi bka' ma nub pa la/ 'jam dbyangs grags rdzong chung ba'ang zer/ pa'am chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa bdud las rnam rgyal dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mgon po rnam rol/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i zin bris rnams la brten nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du bram ze chen po nas nye bar brgyud pa'i mgon po gri gug lha lnga'i rig pa'i dbang lnga/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang*/ brtan byed du chu'i dbang*/ sngags kyi bzlas lung dang bcas pa/ mngon dkyil bshad ma thag pa'i steng nas/

bla ma mal lo'i bzhed pa'i gur mgon lha brgyad kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i dbang lnga/ rjes gnang bzlas lung dang bcas pa/ mngon dkyil de dag la brten nas bla ma brag steng pa'i bzhed pa gur mgon lha bcu gnyis ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i dbang lnga/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang bzlas lung dang bcas pa/ mngon dkyil de khar brten nas rgyud dur khrod nag po'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i gyi ljang lugs kyi mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ chu cod paṇa rdo rje dril bu ming dbang bzlas lung dang bcas pa rnams dkyil chog tu lugs gnyis gsungs pa'i rgya gzhung lugs sor gnas/ yang mngon dkyil de dag la brten nas sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du gri gug lha lnga'i dbang snyan brgyud lugs ltar bzlas lung yan rgya gzhung sor bzhag la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang*/ gsang dbang sher dbang dbang bzhi pa dang bcas pa rnams so// gnyis pa rjes gnang gi bka' ma nub pa'i skor la/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge dang*/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas lo chen gyi bzhed pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lcam dral lha gsum sbags te bsgrub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag len la gzhi byas rgyal tsha lung mang po dang bla ma zhang ston khu dbon gyi phyag bzhes zin bris kyis brgyan te yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge dang bsham sogs mthong brgyud kyi bka' srol ltar lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub thun mong ba'i rjes gnang*/ mgon po rnam rol gyi mngon rtogs dang dam pa gong ma'i phyag len ltar mgon po lha bcu gnyis pa thun mong ba'i rjes gnang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang*/

paṇa chen brang ti pas mdzad pa'i lha bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang gi yi ger 'dor len bgyid pa la brten nas lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/ gtor chog pho nya myur mgyogs dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i tho yig bzhin dus gcig la chig brgyud las mi gnang ba'i lha brgyad thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad kyi steng sgo ma bzhi bsnan pa'i lha bcu gnyis kyi rjes gnang*/ mgon po rnam rol gyi mngon rtogs dang kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi tho yig ltar dus gcig la chig brgyud kho nar gnang ba'i mgon po lha bcu gnyis thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/ rje byams pa rab brtan pas mdzad pa dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pas mdzad pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge so so'i steng nas mgon po khro bo bcu'i rjes gnang bka' rgya shin tu dam pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan kha byang legs sbyar gyi skad du byas pa yod/ gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge la brten nas gsang khrid kyi smin byed lha brgyad kyi steng du las mkhan zangs gri can gyi mngon rtogs bsnan pa'i mgon po lha dgu'i rjes gnang bka' rgya shin tu dam pa/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i yi ge ltar dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i phyi sgrub thun mong ba'i rjes gnang*/ rngog ston bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba can gyi gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang nan chags mar grags pa/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi zin tho dang brgyud pa'i gsung sgros ltar nang gi 'di slar thob rgyus bris/ las mkhan ber nag zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang bka' rgya ma/ yang bshad ma thag pa'i yi ge gnyis dang*/

mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i zangs gri skor gsum gyi rjes gnang gi zin bris la brten nas gcer bu zangs gri can gyi 'di sngon ma thob kyang slar thob rgyu'i dbang gis bris/ rjes gnang*/ sa skya'i sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge dang gsung rgyun phyag bzhes ltar gsang ba'i las mkhan pu ṭa ming sring gi rjes gnang*/ pu ṭa'i rjes gnang gi chings la gzhi mdzad cung zad mi mthun pa brgyud pa'i gsung sgros kyi brgyan te ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i rjes gnang thun mong ba/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i rjes gnang rnams legs par nos nas/ snyan brgyud gnyis pa gdams ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang 'dra ba'i sarga ma log pa'i skor la/ gdams pa'i dngos gzhi dang rgyab brten lung dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs dpyod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa'i phyi khrid rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i yi ge dang*/ de'i lhan thabs kyi tshul du thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i yi ge gnyis la gzhi byas/ yig chung zur 'debs dang brgyud pa'i zhal shes kyis brgyan te/ sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ dngos gzhi zab pa'i gnad lnga dang khyad par gyi man ngag mde kha gdags pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba/ spyi dang bye brag khyad par gsum gyi sgo nas bzlog pa/ bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang rnal 'byor sgos dgra bsgral ba'i sgo nas gsad pa/ rdzas dang dmigs pa la brten pa'i mnan pa'i dmigs khrid rnams dngos bstan nyams su len dgos pa'i nyams khrid/ mtshan bcas rdzas dang 'khor lo la bstan pa sogs la ngo sprod phyag bzhes/ khyad par thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi mde kha gdags pa la gsum gyi nang dam tshig gi 'khor lo sems nyid ye shes kyi rtsal 'don zhes pa rnam rtog bdud bzhi bcom nas tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i gsang ba'i yang snying skal ldan gyi slob bu gcig la chig brgyud du ston pa/

gong gi sa bcad kyis ma zin pa'i drag po sngags rgod kyi man ngag gi khrid/ 'di la brten nas bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis rgya 'dre tshar gcad pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar ba yang yod/ 'di dag la phyi nang gsang gsum du dbye na gdams pa dngos gzhi spyi'i brag rdzong*/ drag po sngags rgod nang gi brag rdzong*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsang ba'i brag rdzong ste zab khrid kha lag tshang ba 'di ni rjes 'brang gi mkhas grub phal cher la ma grags shing gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud du byon pa'i slob bshad kho na yin pas/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ rjes 'brang mkhas dang grub par grags rnams la// thun mong gdams pa'i dpal 'byor mtha' yas mod// gsang chen slob bshad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'di// mkhas rlom phal gyi rna ba'i spyod yul min// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i nyams khrid smin rgyas dang*/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i nang khrid dam gsang khrid du grags pa ni nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten nas bsgrubs pas nang sgrub/ gsang ba sems kyi gnad la brten nas bsgrubs pas gsang sgrub tu grags shing 'di la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod pa la gnyis ka'i rtsa bar gyur pa gong mas mdzad pa'i man ngag mdor bsdus/ de nyid cung zad rgyas su btang ba dam pas mdzad pa dang*/ gsang rten lus la sba ba'i yig chung rnams dang*/ zhal shes la brten nas nang khrid thun mong ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag la sogs pa rgya cher bzhugs shing*/ 'di skabs su rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ yar klungs pas mdzad pa'i man ngag 'di yi ge nag 'gros lta bur bkod pa'i thog ma yin 'dug pas/ gsung las/ gzhan gyis bskul phyir gzhan phan bsam pas bris// snyigs dus nub par dogs pas 'dir brjod bya// zhes dang*/

dpe mkhyud med par ma bris na snyigs dus su song bas brjed pa dang nub kyis dogs nas/ yi ger gsal por 'dri bar srung ma rnams la lo gsum gyi bar gsol ba btab/ ces sogs ltar/ de yan chad du yi ge gsal po med par shes nus/ mal lo'i rjes gnang gi thor/ man ngag phyi sgrub dang nang lus la brten pa rnams sbyin zhes dang*/ sa chen gyi 'byung lugs gtor mar rang nang gi rnal 'byor pa yin na bdag nyid kyi lte ba chos 'byung gru gsum nang du bsdus la bzhag ces gsang rten lus la sba ba'i gnad zab mo zur tsam bstan pa sogs cung zad ma dgongs pa khrid brgya'i nang du/ skyed cing gsed nas phyag bzhi'i srog thig phyung*// gur la'ang 'dra cog yar klungs pa yis sbyar// zhes zur za mdzad pa ni rje btsun grol mchog mkhas grub chen po yin yang phyogs 'di la gzigs pa'i spyan dkyus thung bas thugs su ma shong ba'i gsung tsam mo zhes zur za ba mdzad do// de yang nang khrid kyi khrid tshul la phyi'i brag rdzong gis bskyed rim dang*/ nang gsang gis rdzogs rim byas pa'i lugs dang*/ bskyed rim gong ltar la/ rdzogs rim yar klungs pa lugs kyi nang khrid thun mong bas byas pa'i lugs dang*/ rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa gsang khrid kyis byas pa sogs lugs gsum tsam las dang po ni gong du song zin zin pa dang*/ da lta'i phyag len la gsum pa song na gnyis pa'ang zhar las 'byung bas rje btsun rdo ring pas sam mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i khrid yig yid bzhin nor bu la gzhi byas/ yig chung zhal shes sogs kyis legs par brgyan te/ sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yi ge brgya pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa khrid gzhung du'ang bshad kyang brag rdzong mar rgyas par song bas yang skyor ma dgos/

brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa rdo rje'i lus kyi gnad shes pa la brten nas rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi mgon po mngon du bya ba'i nye lam rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten nas bsnyen pa'i dmigs rim/ 'khor lo lnga ldan dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa'am rbad pa/ las sbyor thun mong ba bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang rnal 'byor sgos dgra bsgral ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor lo lnga ldan gyi khrid dang bcas pa nyams myong yid ches su legs par nos so// de yang zab lam 'di la brten nas gnas skabs kyi dngos grub tu ma zad mchog gi dngos grub kyang bde blag tu bsgrub nus pas/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ zab las ches zab gsang chen snying po'i bcud// dkon las ches dkon yid bzhin rin chen dbang*// mchog las ches mchog snyan brgyud gdams pa 'di// sa skya'i rje btsun thugs kyi nying khu yin// 'di 'dra rtse gcig bsgoms na lta ci smos// thos pa tsam gyis snang srid 'khor 'das chos// kun gyi rang mtshang rjen par ston pa'i phyir// zab par rlom pa gzhan gyis do zla min// zhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa ni bla ma dang gdams ngag la sngon med pa'i mos gus gzhon nu'i dga' bas thugs gting nas tshim zhing shin tu rangs pa'i gsung du mngon zhing*/ dpe 'di rang gi bstan pa 'dzin nges las// gzhan gyi rna bar ming tsam mi bsgrag cing*// snying nas dad kyang bstan pa mi zin na// chos rgyun shod la dpe rgyun sba bar byos// zhes gsungs pa shin tu snying la bcang bya'i bslab par snang ste deng gi dus 'dir la la dag gis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i sgo nas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dang sems can gyi khams la phan par bsgrub pa'i bsam pa dang*/ bla ma dang chos la ci yang mi bsam par/ chos skyong gnyan pa dang gdams pa zab pa'i grags pa tsam la brten nas chos ci thob tu byed kyin 'ongs pa'i slob ma chu shing gi rnam par thar pa 'chang ba'i rigs can la mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba'i zhal gdams su gda'o//

༈ //gnyis pa rgyab brten lung dang 'brel pa'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs gcod pa la/ rtsa ba'i yi ge bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos dkar chag bsgrigs par mdzad pa'i mgon pod me 'bar ma'i skor/ der ma 'dus pa'i yan lag gi yi ge'i skor dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis lcam dral gyi chos skor gsan pa'i yi ge phal cher glegs bam du bsgrigs par mdzad pa dus re zhig na nyang stod rgyal mkhar rtse nas sa skyar spyan drangs tshe chom pos khyer bar glo bur du me 'bar zhing sgra chen po sgrog pa dang 'phar ba la sogs byung bas de nas bzung ste bu yig rnams la'ang me 'bar mar grags pa'i chos sde 'di la/ phyi nang gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i skor dang gsum/ dang po la/ yid ches bskyed pa lo rgyus/ snod ldan du bsgrub pa rjes gnang*/ gang las byung ba'i gzhi'i rgyud/ rtsa ba'i sgrub yig de dag la mkho ba'i las tshogs lhan thabs dang lnga/ dang po la/ rdo rje gdan gyi ka ba nas rgyal rigs pad+ma badz+ra zhes bya bas spyan (mchod rten)(e)(mu)drangs pa'i mgon po 'di nyid gter nas 'byung ba'i lo rgyus/ bka' ma'i lo rgyus zhes pa chos skyong gi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus (mchod rten)tho tsam bla ma'i gsung bzhin rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug gis sa skya dang yar klungs phyogs su bris pa/ gnyis pa snod ldan du bsgrub pa rjes gnang la/ 'gor dpal nag po chen po bsten pa'i gang zag des zhes yod pa'i lcam dral gyi rjes gnang (mchod rten)gi tho bla ma mal gyis mdzad pa las mkhan gyi khyad par ni gud na mchis so sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi cho (mchod rten)(e)(mu)ga nyi mas bskul nas 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis me yos smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin byang 'dam gyi sa'i char mdzad pa/

ngor rdzong gnyis kyi be bum du 'di dang tshig mi 'dra ba 'ga' re 'dug pa zhus dag ma song ba zhig nas mched dam snyam/ nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang (mchod rten)bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung zhang dkon mchog dpal gyis zin bris su byas pa 'di rnams mi la mi spel ba'i bka' rgya can/ gser pod kyi de lha brgyad dang sbyar ba'i 'di dang zhus dag ye mi pher zhing brjed tho lta bu'i 'dra min gnyis 'dug pa zur pa zhig yin par snang ngo*/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi zur 'debs kyi man (mchod rten)ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa zur khang pa slob dpon dkon mchog 'od kyis yi ger bkod pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi chings (mchod rten)bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis phyag len dus dang mthun par rgyas bsdus ci rigs mdzad kyang lan mang du mdzad par bltas shing drung gi gsung las zin bris su yar klungs pa ldong ston seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub par sug bris mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo dpal ma hā kā la'i rjes gnang gi zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang (mchod rten)gi yi ge 'chams sku mi g.yo bar gda'o'i mtha' can/ dngos gzhi lcam dral gyi rjes gnang yin 'dug cing deng sang lha brgyad thun mong ma yin par mdzad pa'i phyag len dang phyogs tsam mthun par tshogs sgom pa nas brgyud pa'ang bris 'dug go/ lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa bla ma (mchod rten)rnams kyis phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin du dpon shes rab bzang pos bskul nas dam pa kun dga' grags kyis tre stod 'bom dgon par yi ger bkod pa/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags lha brgyad ma'i rjes gnang gi yi ger ngos 'dzin mdzad pa mdun du bka' sdod rnams sam zhes pa la dgongs pa 'dra/

'gor khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas zhes yod pa'i dpal mgon lcam dral gyi rjes (mchod rten)(e)gnang gi brjed byang gser pod na lo rgyus 'dra min dang go rim cung zad mi mthun pa snang ba yig skyon du mngon/ btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba/ thun mong ma yin pa lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang bya (mchod rten)thabs rgyas pa bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi phyag len mang du mthong ba la gzhi byas zhang dang brag phug pa'i zin bris dang rgyal tsha lung mang po'i phyag len gyis cung zad brgyan nas bdag cag gi bla ma'i gsung gis rjes su gnang zhing bkas bskul ba dang*/ bshes gnyen grogs mched dam pas nan gyis bskul nas yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis klu'i dgon pa bde chen du sug bris su mdzad pa rnams so// gsum pa gang las byung ba'i gzhi'i rgyud ni/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i dkyil 'khor bsdus (mchod rten)(e)pa'i rtog pa'i le'u glegs bam du 'di tsam las mgon po mngon byung nas rigs drug gi rnam gzhag bstan pa yig tshogs dang*/ khros rgyud kyi le'u bcu par bshad pa sogs rgyud gzhan rnams dpyad gzhir dgongs nas ma bkod dam snyam/ bco lnga pa las khol du phyung ba 'di gyi ljang po ti na yang yod/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang lo tsā ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur las bris pa/ bzhi pa rtsa ba'i sgrub yig la/ 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub kyis rgyud la brten pa'i sgrub skor/ gangs khrod kyi skyes chen rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub skor te gnyis/ dang po la 'gor skad shan sbyar dang*/ bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// tshul khrims sogs ldan bsdu dngos bzhis// zhes yod pa'i sgrub (mchod rten)(rdo rje)thabs rgyas sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa mi gcig tsam ma gtogs gyi ljang po ti na yang yod cing bir+wa pa'i slob ma nag po par bka' sdod/

tshogs bdag gshin rje/ gnod sbyin ltar gyi pho rkyang gi sgrub lugs bzhi bram ze chen pos gsan pa yin/ pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrad+dhā ka ra warma dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ yang mdzad pa po dang sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong ma ltar gyi sgrub thabs (mchod rten)(e)bsdus pa 'gor skad shan sbyar dang rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas zhes yod pa/ dkar chag na chung ngu zer ba 'dug cing gser pod kyi de yig skyon yin nam dbu nas cung zad ma mthun/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar sngon gsungs pa'i rim pas stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i rjes la zhes (mchod rten)yod pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa lo tsā ba ga rod kyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// tho rengs mal nas langs nas zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub (mchod rten)thabs byin gyis brlab pa dang bcas pa slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīrti dang lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīrtis bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal mgon po nag po la phyag 'tshal lo de kho na bzhin du sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas zhes yod pa'i sgrub (mchod rten)(mu)thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ 'di dang lo chen gyis bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs chung ba dang klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gsum 'gyur khyad tsam ma gtogs don gcig ces bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gsung*/ kha skong po ti na'ang bzhugs so/ /'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i dpal mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs dregs pa zil (mchod rten)(rgya)gnon zhes pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bsam yas mchims phur mdzad pa/

'di rgya pad+ma dbang phyug gis gter nas spyan drangs pa rgyal tsha lung mang po nas brgyud pa ma gtogs rje btsun gong ma nas ma brgyud pas bka' gter gnyis med do// bram ze chen pos mdzad pa'i mgon po lha lnga'i dkyil (mchod rten)(rdo rje)(pra)chog paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang 'gos lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang slob dpon sku la sdo byed dang zhes yod pa'i dpal nag po chen po srog gi spu gri'i sgrub (mchod rten)thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags kyis bsgyur ba rnams so/ 'gyur byang tsam ma gtogs gyi ljang na'ang yod/ /gnyis pa gangs can gyi ljongs su byon pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub skor la/ rkyang sgrub dang sbags sgrub gnyis/ ma hā kā las bram ze chen por gnang ba'i sgrub thabs gsum zhes pa rang lugs la pho rkyang mo rkyang sbags sgrub gsum du bzhed/ dang po la pho rkyang du bsgrub pa/ bka' sdod/ tshogs bdag gshin rje/ gnod sbyin ltar grub pa bzhi yod pa lha'i rnams mi 'dra ba bzhi dang bdag mdun sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba rang lugs su bzhed cing*/ rdzong chung ba gshin rje dang gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa'i yi ge logs su ma mthong gsung ba brag steng pa'i sgrub lugs bzhi dang bla chen bsod blo'i man ngag tshigs bcad ma dam pa'i gshin rje ltar sgrub pa sogs ma gzigs pa'i skyon no/ /mo rkyang du bsgrub pa/ 'khor rkyang du bsgrub pa dang gsum/ dang po la 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo spyir bram ze mchog sred kyi mgon po lcam dral sgrub lugs 'di la zhes yod pa'i pho rkyang (mchod rten)(e)(mu)gi sgrub thabs bod yig mar grags pa/ rdzong chung bas dgra dang bgegs la bya ba zhes pa las mdzad pa po ngos ma zin par snang ngo*// mal lo chen pos mdzad pa phyis sa chen gyis zhus dag ma dam tshig bsrung ba dang 'bad pa shin tu gal che'o pho rkyang du bsgrub pa'o'i mtha' can/

'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo brgyud pa bzang ldan mal gyi bu thu bo zhes yod pa'i pho rkyang gi bsnyen bsgrub sbags (mchod rten)(e)(mu)te bsgrub pa 'di'i sbyar byang na puṇ+ya badz+ra gyis sbyar zer ba 'dug cing mkhan chen ngag chos pa'i gsan yig na'ang de ltar snang la/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ lo pa spyan snga/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba gsum gyi gsan yig na dkar chag sor gnas bzhin mdzad 'dug pa don la gcig ser pod na kha skong nang gi pho rkyang gi sgrub thabs shog sngon can gnyan phul byung bas mdzad par ngos bzung nas 'di la rkyang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma zhes pa las gnyan phul byung bas mdzad pa'i 'phros mi 'dug la/ rdzong chung ba'i der bgegs la bya ba man chad ma tshang zhing slob dpon rtse mos mdzad ces snang ngo*/ /sa chen gyi slob ma gnyan phul byung bas mdzad pa/ 'gor oṃ swa sti bla ma dang nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo kā la'i man ngag la yig rnying snga ma'i 'phros zhes pa dkar chag dang dpe'i zhal byang gnyis kar snang*/ zhes dang mjug (mchod rten)tu sa skya jo sras kyi yi ge man ngag rnying pa snga ma'i 'phros sa māp+ta'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ swa sti dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// rten gyi gang zag dbang bzhi'i snod du rung ba zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po'i 'byung lugs bstan (mchod rten)cing gtor ma dang po'i 'phros kyi yi ge rnying pa'i cha lag gong mas mdzad pa rje btsun gyi bla dpe las bris pa/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo bhe dan gyi yul na bram ze mchog sred ces yod pa'i tshogs kyi bdag (mchod rten)(mu)po'i tshul du sgrub pa'i u pa de sha sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ mgon po khro bcu tshogs bdag ltar sgrub par ngos 'dzin yang*/ de'i rjes gnang gis mal lo'i lugs kyi pho rkyang la rjes gnang med par bzhed pa la mi gnod pa 'dra ste/

de ni gtso rkyang la dgongs kyi 'di ni pho rkyang gtso 'khor sbags sgrub yin pas so snyam zhing*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan du sbags sgrub yin pas so rje tshar pa gsung ba'i ngag rgyun de legs po snang zhes pa 'dug kyang*/ sa bcad du rkyang sgrub sbags sgrub ces so sor dbye ba'i dbang du song na 'di lugs gnyis gang du'ang ngos 'dzin dka' ba'i dogs gnas che ba zhig 'dug go /'gor bla ma dang dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo tshogs kyi bdag po'i tshul du sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub gnyis sngon du song nas las (mchod rten)(mu)(rdo rje)la sbyar ba zhes yod pa'i man ngag gi yig rnying rdzong chung ba ser ba dbab pa gzhung gi yig sna'i zhabs na yod ces logs su ngos bzung ba de 'di'i nang gi de'o/ ser ba bcad pa'i las rnams sgrub thabs nyid las btsal rdzong chub ba gsal zhes sgra bshad dang bcas gsung*/ lo'i mtha' can/ de'i bsad las 'gor dpal (mchod rten)(rdo rje)nag po chen po sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyi man ngag bsad pa'i las sbyor ro'i mtha' can/ 'gor ma hā kā la'i bsnyen pa (mchod rten)(mu)(rdo rje)yang dang po lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro bar bya ste zhes yod pa'i bka' bsgo'i tshul du sgrub pa bla ma gong mas mdzad pa sgra snyan gyi rdzas rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rdzong chung pa 'di'i nang gi sreg rdzas la ba la ta ka'i rdzas dang bcas bsad smyo dbye gsum so sor kha bsgyur chog pa sgrub thabs nyid nas gsal zhes zhal 'phangs pa 'dir ngos bzung 'dug yang des mdzad pa'i 'gor dang por bdag nyid kyis bsnyen sngags dang sngags ring gnyis ka la bsnyen pa (mchod rten)(mu)(rdo rje)bskyal zhes yod pa'i ling ga bsregs pa'i dum bu lam rgya gram du mnan no'i mtha' can/
