dpal mgon por gsol ba btab pas gnang ba'i skabs thob nas kha'u brag rdzong du mdzad pa/ srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong gi nyams len gyi yi ge rgyas pa tshar chen gyis yun ring nas bskul zhing yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas nag po chen pos gnang ba'i skabs thob ste kha'u brag rdzong gi gnas mchog tu sbyar ba/ 'gor na mo gu ra we/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i srung 'khor brag rdzong gi nang gi nyams len zhes yod pa'i drag po sngags rgod kyi man ngag gsung gi bdud rtsi i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// bsgom pa'i man ngag la gsum gyi dang po zhes yod pa'i nang dam tshig gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba gsang ba'i brag rdzong ma'i yi ge snod dang ldan pa la sbyin gyi gzhan la ni ma yin no'i mtha' can/ phyi nang gi khrid yig 'di rnams nyams khrid ma thob par gnang srol mi 'dug go /ser ba srung ba'i yi ge 'jug tu/ 'di 'dra'i man ngag gdams pas ni// ser ba thub pa the tshom med// rang gi slob mas bskul nas ni// snyan brgyud gdams pa bris pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod// ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad yod pa/ sngags pa nang rgyas kyi man ngag shin tu gsang zhing sba bar bya zhes pa'i mtha' can dus gcig tu chig brgyud kyi gras/ las mgon bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i gtor chog tshar chen gyis bskul ba la brten nas kha'u brag rdzong du mdzad pa rnams so// drug pa rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i yi ge la/ me 'bar ma'i dkar chag snying po gnad kyi sgron me tshigs bcad ma/ mgon po'i man ngag zab bsdus kha skong rnams kyi dkar chag zab don gsal ba'i sgron me/ snyan brgyud zhal shes yi ger bkod pa'i dkar chag gsang chen gnad kyi za ma tog gyi ljang lugs kyi khog phub dkar chag zab don gnad kyi lde mig 'dod khams dbang phyug dud sol ma'i dkar chag snyan brgyud gsal ba'i me long*/

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i lha dang chos skor byung tshul gyi lo rgyus man ngag gi khog phub snyan brgyud rin po che'i lde mig 'gor na maḥshrī gu ru badz+ra ma hā kā la ya/ gur gyi mgon po khro bcu'i zhes yod (zha)pa'i mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang gi yi ge bkra shis seṅge des bdag blo gsal la'o'i mtha' can/ las mgon zangs gri can rnam gnyis kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge chos rje tshul khrims pa des bdag la'o'i mtha' can/ dpal sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga snyan brgyud zab mo'i man ngag gis rnam par brgyan pa'i phrin las myur mgyogs kyi pho nya/ 'gor bla ma mchog dang dpal he ru ka dbyer med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhes yod pa'i mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor chog mi dbang gzhon nu'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor gtsang stod zhwa lu'i chos grwar sbyar ba/ 'gor bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhes yod pa'i lcam dral gyi gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru sogs brjod kyi mtha' can/ 'gor na maḥshrī ma hā kā lā ya/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgo nas tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa zhes yod pa'i gur mgon dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi yi ge dgyes pas bskyang du gsol gyi mtha' can/ mgon po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga (zha)dngos grub rin chen bang mdzod/ brgyud 'debs rnam kun mchog ldan ma/ srung 'khor ('a)gsang khrid ljags lung dngos gzhi'i skabs gsang khrid man gyi dpe ma 'byor/ dang bcas pa rgyun du nyams su len tshul kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor ba'i snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu rdo rje'i mched zla ar+tha sid+dhi shrī maṃ gyi nyams len du zho lung mtsho kha'i ri khrod du mdzad pa/

dpal gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad sbags te bsgrub pa'i srung 'khor mdun khang 'phags pa'i yi ge'i gsal (zha)byed rje bla ma ma hā kā la'i gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs te tho tsam bkod pa/ 'di'i nyams len yod na nad yams sogs yul phyogs tsam du yang mi 'byung zhes rgwa ā nan dam pas che ba dpag tu med pa mdzad pas zab gnad ma'o// 'gor gu ru badz+ra n+ha ra na mo/ gsang sgrub kyi skabs su rje bla ma'i gsung nas zhes yod pa'i gsang sgrub kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i gsung sgros snying gi dkyil las gzhan du ma yin no'i mtha' can chig brgyud kyi gras/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi le'u bco lnga pa dkyil 'khor chen po bsdus pa'i rtog pa las nang sgrub dang gsang sgrub bstan tshul pha rgod rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin de ma thag tu zin bris bgyis pa/ gsang rten bla rdo bcang thabs/ 'di'i sbyar byang du/ dam can 'khu ldog spong ba'i gdams pa'i bcud// rtsa brgyud bla mas cung zad yig ris su// mdzad kyang nam mkha'i mdzub ris ji bzhin du// snyan brgyud zhal shes bral bas rtogs mi nus// 'dir ni ma sbas lag len lhug par bris// bka' drin dran no rje btsun kha'u pa// gsang chen bstan pa gtad do snying gi bu// zhes mdo khams rdo rje bkra shis la gnang ba yin pas bka' rgya shin tu dam par 'dug cing chig brgyud kyi gras kyang yin/ nang sgrub kyi 'khor lo lnga'i las sbyor thun mong ma yin pa spu gri so 'debs kyi gdams pa rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i phyag bris dngos zin bris thor bu 'khrugs can du bzhugs pa las bka'i gnang ba zhus te dkyus su bris pa chig brgyud ma'i gras/ 'gor na mo badz+ra ā tsār+ya/ dam can rgya mtsho'i yum chen ma// zhes yod pa'i e ka dza ṭī la brten nas rims nad bsrung ba'i gdams pa rje btsun rdo ring pa'i gsung gi nying khu sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/

nag po chen po la klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgo nas char 'bebs pa'i yi ge zhag gsum tshun la 'bab par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo gu ru/ bla ma dang ma hā kā la'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir mgon po dbyer med du bsre ba zhes yod pa'i chos skyong gi snying chu bsre ba'i zhal shes kyi yi ge mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung brjed byang du bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i zab gnad kyi bsdus don nam thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi sa bcad mthong smin dge legs kun 'byung du grags pa/ brag rdzong ma'i mde kha gdags pa'i man ngag phyi rol rdzas kyi sbyor ba'i man ngag zhal shes mal phur gyi yi ge dbon chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas mdzad pa bka' rgya dam pa'i gras/ 'gor oṃ swa sti/ dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa'i srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i yig chung las zhes yod pa'i gtor ma la brten nas dgra bgegs rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i man ngag gi yi ge lta ba'i ngang du bzhag rjes spyi ltar bya'o'i mtha' can/ ser ba srung 'bebs kyi man ngag dug gi rlung chen nag po zhar 'byung thog srung shwa bzlog dang bcas pa dpal brag mig chos rdzong gi yang dben du mdzad pa/ dam can srung ma rnams la phyi rten 'dzugs pa'i lag len gyi yi ge nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du gtsang rong mtsho la'i mgul gyi ri khrod bsam gtan rtser sbyar ba/ gnas de nyid du mdzad pa'i dam can srung ma rnams kyi thun mong gi ru mtshon 'dzugs pa'i yi ge zab gnad 'di dag la brten nas chos srung rnams mtsho la ngang pa dang sha rul la sbrang ma ltar 'dus pas kha'u skyed lhas/ rtses thang bsam gtan gling*/ phan yul dpal ldan rtse sogs srung ma rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas yin zhes pa'ang gnad 'gag zab mo la brten pa yin gyis/ snang shas dbang gis khang pa'i yang thog rtser// rnga thug 'dzugs pa'i skye bo mang na yang*// brgyud pa'i man ngag lag len dang ldan pa// 'di 'dra shes pa'i sngags 'chang nyin skar tsam// zhes gsungs pa don la gnas pas zab gnad mi shes pa'i lder bzo gog po tsam la yid gtod par mi bya'o// nag po chen po'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi cho ga dgra bgegs kyi stobs 'phrog rol pa/

'di ni mgon po la brten pa'i gtor bzlog gi cho ga 'khrul pa med pa yin la/ deng sang dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi tshab la mgon po dang las gshin gyi tshab tu pu tras byas pa'i mgon po drug cu par grags pa sogs ni zur za ba'i yul du byed pa'ang yod do// bstod bskul 'og min bde chen ma/ dam can pu tra'i bskang gso phrin las lhun grub/ de'i bskang rdzas byin rlabs rlung ltar 'tshub ste byon par gyur/ badz+ra sa mā dza'i mtha' can/ chos skyong gi dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar rnams so// bdun pa dkar chag tu mi bzhugs pa'i yig cha'i skor la/ mthu chen ā nan dam pas mdzad pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu pas mdzad pa/ kha'u brag rdzong pa'i phyag len du mdzad pa'i bstod 'bum dang bcu gnyis/ dang po ni/ nang sgrub la brten pa'i bsnyen pa/ mi 'khu mi ldog srog tig blang ba'i gnad 'jam par bsgrub pa/ las sbyor/ myur ba'i gnad/ gtor ma'i man ngag dang bcas pa/ ma hā kā la'i spu gri so 'debs kyi man ngag shin tu rno myur du bsgrub par grags pa/ dus gcig tu chig brgyud kyi gras/ gnyis pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog spong bar (zha)rgyu rtags nyes dmigs/ mi ldog pa'i man ngag gi phyi rol lha sogs gnad drug 'di gnyis gzhan du zhal 'phangs/ nang sngags sogs gnad drug gi man ngag gsang ba yang tig sems kyi gnad lnga la brten nas bran bzhin bkol ba'i zab pa'i gnad kyi man ngag spogs chog

'di gzhan du kha 'phangs/ dang bcas pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu gzhan la phan pa'i blos mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gsol ba btab ste mdo smad gnyan tshe'i sa'i char sbyar ba/ mjug na/ bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// bstan la sems pa'i bu yi mchog /snying dang 'dra ba cig la sbyin// gzhan la mang du spel gyur na// las mkhan pu tra 'khor bcas kyis// mgo chod snying khrag zhal du gsol// zhes bka' rgya dam par snang ngo*// 'khu ldog spong ba'i sa bcad bzhi pa'i zhal 'phangs pa spogs chog gi gsal byed srog phur gyis gnad du bsdigs pas las myur du 'grub pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i yi ge rang gi dran pa gso phyir bris pa/ rje btsun rdo ring pas mdzad pa'i yig cha 'di rnams 'khrugs sdebs su gong du'ang bzhugs/ 'gor na mo gu ru/ mgon po'i gtor chen bya bar 'dod pas rnal 'byor pa kha lhor bltas zhes yod pa'i mgon po lha brgyad (zha)kyi gtor bzlog gi phyag len dben gnas kha'u brag rdzong du sbyar ba rnams/ bzlas pa spyi'i sngon 'gro brgyad/ so so'i khyad par bstan pa gsum gyi zhal shes skal bar (zha)ldan pa rnams kyi don du legs par sbyar ba/ mjug na/ snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag dam pa 'di// kun la mi sbyin gsang ba'i bka' rgya yod// snod ldan dag la chig brgyud tshul du sbyin// gzhan la rgya cher mang du spel gyur na// las kyi mgon pos zangs gri rnon po yis// de yi mgo chod yan lag rgyan du gyis// man ngag rin chen snying gi dkyil du chongs// zhes snang ngo*// chos tshan bzhi po dus gcig la chig brgyud du gnang ba'i bka' rgya can yin cing*/ las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro zhes pa kha sbyor dbye ba brgyad kyi man ngag lung yang snang ngo'i mtha' can/ rig sngags go ldog yig chung*/ nag po chen po'i sgo nas phrin las gang sgrub kyang gtor ma bca' shes dgos sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi gtor ma'i rnam (zha)gzhag bzod par gsol ba'i mtha' can/

lcam dral gyi gtor ma (zha)bsham thabs don gsum pa dam pa kun dga' grags las brgyud pa man ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ gsum pa rje btsun rdo ring pas mdzad pa ni/ spyi don gsum pa dgra bo rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i zhal shes gtor ma (zha)'phangs na de ni rang gshed rang gis byed nges so'i mtha' can/ bzhi pa rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa dang gsung rgyun zin bris la/ nag po chen po'i chos skor gyi khog phub man ngag gi rnam par bshad (zha)pa zab don snyan brgyud kyi rol mtsho legs bshad kyi rba rlabs rnam par g.yo ba mchod pa bsham pa man 'phror lus pa/ khro bcu'i rjes gnang gi skabs nye bar mkho ba'i sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur ba'i man ngag rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'i mtha' can/ ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i rjes gnang bka' gtad kyi yi ge snyan brgyud sbas don gsal ba nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa/ 'gor na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa la zhes yod pa'i mgon po lha (pha)brgyad kyi srung 'khor gyi yi ge snyan brgyud rdo rje'i go khrab sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i zhal shes ni zhes yod pa'i brag rdzong ma'i srung 'khor thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes zin bris rdo rje'i go khrab khyad par gyi man ngag mde kha gdags pa dang bcas pa bkra shis bde bas khyab pa deng 'dir stsol gyi mtha' can chig brgyud ma'i gras/ nang sgrub kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i las sbyor gyi nang tshan snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i las sbyor rnal 'byor sgos dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon cha mdo khams pa rdo rje bkra shis la gnang ba/ 'di'i mjug tu/ snyan brgyud nying khu yin gyi bslus pa med// snying dkyil sbos la bsnyen sgrub tshad du skyol// khas zhan skyabs dang bral ba'i dus byung na// mtshon 'di phyung la sdig can chos dbyings skyol// de min nyes chung tsam la mi rtsom zhing*// zhes gsungs pas bag dang ldan pa gnad du che zhing chig brgyud ma'i gras so// rdo rje'i chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams mnyes byed gtor sgrub bskang gso'i phyag len gyi gsal byed lhan thabs dngos grub rol mtsho bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi phyag len 'khrul med du bkod pa/

dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor ma gsum gyi rnam bshad kyi zhal shes thun mong ma yin pa snying gi khrag lta bu'i gdams pa zor 'phen pa man cung zad mdzad 'phror lus pa chig brgyud ma'i gras/ gur mgon pho brgyud mo brgyud zhal stag zhon dang bcas pa'i dmod bcol gyi yi ge 'gor so so'i sngags dang gur bzhin 'dri'o'i mtha' can/ mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel (zha)gur mgon la bcol ba'i dam bsgrags/ gsung sgros zin bris la/ 'gor oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan zhes yod pa'i mgon chen gyi dam tshig gso ba'i bskang gso'i zin bris rjes chog rnams dkyus bzhin mdzad do'i mtha' can/ gur zhal sprel ma'i gtor chen gyi zin bris zor lam dbye ba sogs lhan thabs ji lta ba bzhin mdzad do'i mtha' can/ sku rten bris 'bur bzheng tshul/ rab gnas zhag bdun ma/ gsung rten glegs bam/ thod rnga/ rnga chen/ rkang gling bzheng pa/ thugs rten rdo rje gri gug thod pa/ gaṇ+ḍi/ rtse gsum bzheng pa/ phyi rten rta g.yag sogs phyi ru bcas te nor rdzas bsrung ba/ nang rten nang du bcas te bang mdzod bsrung ba zhar byung thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ru mtshon/ byang chen mchod rten/ 'phan nag ba dan/ zhwa nag l+h+wam nag gos nag gsang mdos/ pho mo'i gsang rten/ gsang rten gsang bar bcas te mkha' 'gro 'khu ldog spong ba/ gzhan yang pu tra'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rten/ nor srung gnod sbyin pho mo'i tshul du bsgrub pa'i rten dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal shes thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung rgyun mdo khams pa rdo rje bkra shis kyis zin bris su bkod pa snod dang ldan nges la chig brgyud ma/ 'di lung rgyun lta ci dpe rgyun yang dkon zhing 'di nas rab gnas zhag bdun ma khol du phyung ste zur du bris pa'i yi ge yang mthong ngo*// lnga pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa la/

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid yig sa skya tshad kyi rna bar ma grags pa'i snying nang gi zungs khrag lta bu lcags byi snron gyi zla ba'i nyer lnga la tshong 'dus 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i lte ba rgyal po'i pho brang chen po'i gzims chung chos rgyal pho brang du mdzad pa/ de'i sbyar byang du/ rang bzo'i 'jigs 'jigs bsgrigs pa'i rdo phal mdog /'brel med mgal dum spel ba'i rnyog ma can// nyams len 'od dkar spros tshe skal ldan gyi// snying gi pad+mo zum dang 'di mi 'dra// zhes gsungs pa rdo ring kun rgyan pa sogs kyis man ngag ma tshang ba'i ras rul bsdus nas 'chad pa rnams la dgongs pa 'dra'o// rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten nas sgrub pa nang sgrub dang gsang ba yang gsang sems kyi gnad la brten nas sgrub pa'i gsang khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ khrid ma thob par lung gi gnang ba dkyus gcig cing sbyar byang du/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// snyan brgyud kho nar byon pa'i gsang chen 'di// snying dbus chongs la nyams len rgyun du skyongs// kun la ma spel snod ldan gcig la byin// zhes pa ltar rje btsun kha'u pa yab sras yan la chig brgyud kho nar bzhugs pas kun la ma grags shing*/ dpyod ldan gyis dpyad na rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab kyi tshig zur la zab gnad 'di 'dra thugs la gab nas yod par shes nus kyang*/ rje btsun grol mchog sogs rjes 'brang mang po'i thugs su ma chud pa tsu ta'i yul gyi rkang gnyis pa ltar ro// 'gor oṃ swa sti/ bdag gi bla ma tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas zhes yod pa'i lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang ()thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge pha bla ma'i bka' gnang thob nas brjed thor bkod pa shu bhaṃ gyi mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ swa sti/ bdag cag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po zhes yod pa'i lha bcu gnyis ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris su bgyis so'i mtha' can/

'gor bran bdud kyi rjes gnang thun mong ba'i phyag len ni zhes yod pa'i zin bris rjes gnang bka' rgya can no'i mtha' can/ 'di gsum rjes gnang ma thob par mi gnang ba'i bka' rgya can/ 'gor na maḥshrī gu ru ma hā kā lā ya/ de la rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsnyen pa la gsum (zha)ste zhes yod pa'i bsnyen pa'i man ngag dpe 'di mi la mi ston pa'i bka' rgyas btab yod lags kyi mtha' can chig brgyud ma'i gras/ lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub kyi mchod pa'i cho ga dam can 'du ba'i mchod (zha)sprin mi dbang ma ṇi bha dra'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas bde gsal rab brten du bkod pa/ bka' srung zangs gri skor gsum gyi gtor 'bul (zha)sde snod rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i drung pa bslab gsum pas bskur bar brten nas 'brug lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyer gsum la mdzad pa/ ma hā kā la'i chos skor thob pa'i brjed (zha)byang bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba rnams so// drug pa rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa la/ 'gor nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa la thog mar gzhi skye med dngos po'i gnas tshul zhes yod pa'i yar klungs pa'i gur mgon (zha)nang khrid kyi zhal shes mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dgon gsar pa bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung rgyun zin bris su mdzad pa hūm̐ la sems gtad nas bsgom pa sogs sngar bzhin no'i mtha' can chig brgyud gras/ gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge (sa)glang bu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug gis bskul ba la brten nas bla ma mgon po dang bcas pa la gsol ba btab nas mdzad pa 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung ma thob pa la rna ba'i lam tsam du yang mi bsgrag pa'i bka' rgya can/ dri chu la brten pa'i rims bsrung (zha)mi 'dra ba rnams kyi nang nas pha bla ma bslab gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis thugs gtsigs su gnang ba zin bris su bkod pa/

mgon po khro bcu'i brgyud 'debs bdud las rnam par rgyal (zha)ba rigs brgya'i mkhyen brtse ma mi dbang tshe dbang don grub kyis bskul nas zhwa lu ri sbug tu mdzad pa/ yang rje bslab gsum pa'i gsung la zin bris su mdzad pa'i rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i bsdus (zha)don gyi yi ge rje nyid kyi spyan sngar zhus dag pa nyams khrid 'di nyid mkhan chen bslab gsum pa kho na'i bka' drin las byung bas/ sbyar byang du/ blo 'das gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang*// gang 'dul dag pa'i zlos gar drin chen rje// bka' drin dran no pha rgod bslab gsum zhabs// snying nas 'du 'bral med do thugs rjes skyong*// zhes drin bzo'i tshul du bstod pa ni brgyud pa dang bla ma la ci yang mi sems pa'i chos 'dod mkhan po rnams la dgongs pa 'dra'o// brag rdzong ma'i gtor ma la brten nas rang gshed 'bebs pa'i man ngag rgwa ā nan dam pa sogs gong ma mang po'i yi ger tho tsam las mi gsal ba'i gsal byed nag 'gros su mgon po khro bcu'i gtor bzlog gi cho ga (zha)bdud las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ skyed tshal mkhan po thar pa bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas chos sde de kha'i mgon khang du mdzad pa rnams so// bdun pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa la/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma (ngag)yin pa bla ma gong ma'i rjes gnang (sha)gi yi ge rnying pa las tshig sna bsrings te rgyas su btang ba/ zangs gri can skor gsum gyi rjes gnang gi zur (ngag)'debs rje bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan gyi phyag bzhes rang gi yid la gang zin tsam zhig phyag len zin bris su bkod pa/ 'di gnyis rjes gnang ma thob par mi gnang ba'i bka' rgya can/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung rgyun/ phyi srung ba'i 'khor lo la brten nas sgrub pa'i brag rdzong gi khrid kyi yi ge 'dod (ngag)dgu'i dpal ster tsha lung dgon par shing rta'i lor zin bris su mdzad pa/

rin po che rta rwa bas nang gi brag rdzong ma'i khrid rgya (ngag)'dre tshar bcad pa'i lo rgyus kyang snang bas shin tu zab gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ gsang ba'i brag rdzong sems nyid ye shes kyi rtsal 'don gyi khrid (ngag)rig sngags 'chang ba'i gtsug rgyan bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung la tsha lung dgon par zin bris su mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i gsang khrid kyi yi ge rin po che rta rwa ba'i gsung sgros yid bzhin nor bu (ngag)de bla ma'i bzhugs gnas tsha lung dgon par zin bris su zla ba dgu pa'i nyer gsum gyi nyin rdzogs par grub pa rnams nyams khrid ma thob par mi gnang ba phyag len gyi rgyun bzhin no// brgyad pa lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub kyis mdzad pa la/ nang gi brag rdzong drag po sngags rgod kyi (lo)nyams len rje bla ma mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsung bzhin dpal ldan sa skya'i lha chen gsang ba'i mgon khang du sbyar ba/ brag rdzong ma'i sngags pa nang rgyas kyi man ngag gi zhal shes lus dbral ba/ stobs gzhom pa/ rnam shes spor ba gsum gyi gdams pa (lo)khyad par can spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsung bzhin 'jam dbyangs gdung brgyud la yab chos phul ba'i tshe lha chen gsang ba'i mgon khang du sbyar ba/

'di dang dbyibs 'dra ba zhig tshar chen dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa deng sang lung rgyun chad 'dug pas 'di nyid mkho bar snang ngo*// yi ge gnyis ka chig brgyud kyi gras/ dgu pa rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa ni/ rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sku rten bzheng tshul ('a)dang khyad par gyi rab gnas bya tshul gsal ba'i me long chig brgyud ma/ bcu pa khyab bdag zhwa lu (zha)pas mdzad pa ni/ brag rdzong ma'i rdzas bzlog las kyi mtshon cha/ tshad med bzhi/ lce byin brlab/ bzlas pa/ skyabs yul/ dgra bgegs kyi sa bon/ thal rdeb/ 'khor lo 'khor lugs/ thun bsdu ba/ bzlog pa'i sku'i tshad rnams kyi zhal shes rnams kyang chig brgyud ma'o// bcu gcig pa kha'u brag rdzong pa'i phyag len du mdzad pa'i bstod 'bum la/ srin gzugs ma'i sh+lau ka gsum/ 'di yan me 'bar mar yang yod/ 'gor yod pa'i dpal ldan mgon po ma (mu)'phags pas mdzad pa/ rdzong kha bas rgyud nas phyung gsung yang lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan du pod mar bzhed pas dpyad do// e ka dza ṭī'i bstod pa kun bzang ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa (mu)til mar ma/ de'i bstod pa rgya (mu)mtsho'i klong gnas ma/ zhal gyi bstod pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i dpal ldan dbang ldan ma/ mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i gur gyi bstod pa (mu)sngon tshe bde gshegs ma/ me 'bar ma dang gyi ljang po tir yang yod/ mal los lha mor bstod pa (mu)gang gi sku gsung ma/ rdzong chung pa 'phags pa rin po ches mi nyag tu mdzad par bzhed/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i phrin bcol khyod kyi phrin las ma/ gnam kha'u pas mgon po gdong bzhi pa zhal gzigs dus bstod pa'i rdo rje 'chang dbang ma/ zhabs btags mar yang yod/ 'phags pas mgon por bstod pa gang (mu)thugs ma/ 'di me 'bar mar yang yod/ paṇ+ḍi ta lo ka shrī'i sgrub thabs las byung ba'i mchog sred kyis lha (mu)mo la bstod pa mi pham srid gsum ma/

dud sol phyi sgrub kyi rgya gzhung na'ang yod/ gnyan los zhal la bstod pa paṃ pad raṃ nyi ma/ las mgon rnams kyi bstod pa mgon po'i bka' (mu)nyan ma/ bstod pa nag po rngams pa ma/ dpal ldan dbang ldan ma'i sh+lau ka gcig bcug 'dug pa ma gtogs kha skong bstod 'bum dang zhabs btags mar yang yod/ bskul mgon po ma hā kā la ma rnams/ gzhan yang khro bcu'i phrin las bskul ba mkha' dbyings dag klong ma sa rta rgyal zla la pho brang du 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ khro bo bcu gcig gi gtor 'bul dang bstod pa ser sna rnam dag ma mkhan chen gnas drug pas rgyud las phyung ba/ yang des rgyud las phyung ba'i bskul byang chub sems bskyed ma/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa me stag thim 'gyur ma rnams kyang thob bo// rtsa ba'i gsum pa bla ma gyi ljang lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i gyi ljang po ti'i skor ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i khog phub yi ge'i dkar chag zab don gnad kyi lde mig de las byung ba'i chos skor la/ sngon du 'gro ba lo rgyus kyi yi ge snod rung du bya ba dbang dang rjes gnang gi yi ge rtsa bar gyur pa rgyud kyi yi ge nyams su len pa sgrub thabs kyi yi ge dkar chag tu ma 'khod pa'i yi ge dang lnga/ dang po la/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje nag po chen po'i skye rgyud ni zhes yod pa'i yig rnying (mchod rten)gur mgon gyi skye rgyud rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// de la sngon gyi dus na rgyal bu gcig dang blon po'i bu gcig gis zhes yod pa'i (rdo rje)lha dngos kyi lo rgyus dang bram ze mchog sred sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams ston pa'i yi ge dge slong dharmā gzi brjid la gnang ba lags so'i mtha' can/ rdzong chung pa dam pas mdzad pa'i lcam dral gnyis ka'i lo rgyus 'dren pas mtshon te/

rgyud sgrub thabs bstod pa thams cad du lha mo'i rnam gzhag mdzad kyang lugs 'di la lha mo'i sgros med pas 'thad par ma mngon zhing kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa dang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje gnyis kyang mi bzhed do// 'di dharma gzi brjid kyis mdzad ces dkar chag na 'dug go /gnyis pa snod rung du bya ba dbang dang rjes gnang gi yi ge la/ dpal nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bram (rdo rje)(mu)ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po la li ta badz+ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje gdan pa gcig lha lnga dang gcig bcu bdun pa'i dbang chog yin par bzhed pa gsan yig dang phyag dpe gnyis kar 'dug pa brjod don lhag po mi 'dug pas dpyad dgos par snang ngo*/ /'di dang tshig sna ring thung cung zad yod pa'i mchan bu dang bcas pa nag po ro 'dzin dang gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba dang dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog la li ta badz+ra 'di phal cher dur khrod rnams su bzhugs pas mtshan dur khrod nag po ro 'dzin du grags zhes khog phub dang rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu snang na'ang 'dir dbang chog 'dra min gnyis byung ba'i sngon mar la li ta dang*/ phyi ma la nag po ro 'dzin zhes so sor byung ba dang 'byung khungs bsdus don na mi gcig par bshad cing 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na'ang so sor snang ba brtag dgos 'dug go /'gor dpal nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di la spyi don gsum ste zhes yod pa'i dbang chog rgya gzhung gi sa (rdo rje)bcad dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba'o rdzogs so'i mtha' can dharma gzi brjid kyis mdzad pa/ 'gor ye shes mgon po'i dbang bskur ba'i rjes la zhes yod pa'i bran bdud rjes gnang gi zur (mu)'debs kyi yi ge las mgon gyi rjes gnang rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams so/

yig cha dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na rjes gnang gi yi ge rnying pa zhes snang ngo*// gsum pa rtsa bar gyur pa rgyud kyi yi ge la/ 'gor bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes yod pa'i gtso rkyang ston (mchod rten)pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa las phyung ba/ 'di me 'bar mar yang bzhugs/ lha bcu bdun dngos ston pa dur khrod nag po'i rgyud brtag pa bcu gnyis (rdo rje)(mu)pa bla ma nag po ro 'dzin dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di'i sngags btu'i le'u'i 'gyur khyad tshigs bcad ma lo paṇa gnyis kyi g.yar dam brgyud pa zhes dkar chag tu gsungs pa le'u bcu gcig pa 'di kha las logs su ma rnyed cing rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na'ang mi snang ngo*// nag po chen po 'di'i rgyud la dur khrod chen po sku'i rgyud/ dur khrod nag po gsung gi rgyud/ gri gug brtsegs pa thugs kyi rgyud ces gsum yod pa las glegs bam du yang dur khrod nag po'i rgyud las mi bzhugs shing nyams len man ngag rnams kyang 'di kho na la brten pa'o// rdzong chung pa'i dkar chag na lha mo srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud drangs shing gter ma yin pas gyi ljang du 'thad mi 'thad the tshom mdzad 'dug kyang rang lugs la dogs pa tsam yang ma dgos so// rgyud kyi don 'grel bzhi sdom bcu (mu)pa slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ dkar chag dang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang yang yig cha na la li tas mdzad zer ba 'gyur byang dang nor ram brtag dur khrod nag po'i 'byung khungs stong thun (mu)gyi khog don bsdus pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ rdzong chung pa'i dkar chag na phyis kyi bla ma dag gis mdzad ces snang ngo*/ /rgyud dur khrod nag po'i bsdus (rdo rje)don sa bcad dge slong dharma gzi brjid kyis sbyar ba/

des mdzad pa'i dur khrod nag po'i rgyud kyi rnam (rdo rje)par bshad pa rdo rje'i tshig don gsal byed rnams so/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na rgyud rtog pa bcu gnyis pa'i 'grel pa zhes snang*/ /bzhi pa nyams su len pa sgrub thabs kyi yi ge la/ mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ las mgon gyi sgrub thabs/ las sbyor thor bu'i yi ge dang gsum/ dang po la gang zag dbang po rab spros pa la mi dga' ba'i don du rdo rje gur dang dur khrod nag po'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa thun mong ba slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i 'gor skad shan sbyar dang*/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// tshul khrims la sogs bsdu dngos bzhi// zhes yod pa'i sgrub (mchod rten)(rdo rje)(mu)thabs bsdus pa dpa' bo 'di me 'bar mar yang yod/ gcig pa'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta nag po ro 'dzin yig cha na paṇ+ḍi ta a thu la badz+ra zhes snang ba brtag dang lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor dpal nag po chen po me 'bar mar yang yod/ dpa' bo gcig pa sras kyi tshul du zhes yod (rdo rje)pa'i gong gi bsdus don bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa bstan pa'o'i mtha' can/ sgrub thabs 'bring po 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// mi bsad mtshon nam seng ldeng la/ khog phub na phur bu'i sgrub skor rnams la gzhan yang zhes sgrub thabs che 'bring chung gsum du mi gtogs pa'i zur par mdzad na'ang*/ dkar chag tu sgrub thabs 'bring por ngos bzung bas de don bzhin bkod pa yin zhing me 'bar po tir yang yod/ rdo rje gdan pa'i phyag dper dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs kyi stod 'dra ba la smad mi 'dra ba zhig 'di'i tshab tu 'dug nag po khros pa'i sku byas la zhes yod pa'i dpal (mchod rten)mgon po nag po phur bu'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa la li ta badz+ra dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/

'gor skad shan sbyar dang*/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan pa gnas par bya ba'i phyir// nag po chen po'i phur bu sgrub// ces yod pa'i nag (mchod rten)(rdo rje)(mu)po chen po'i srog phur gyi yi ge'am phur bu gdab pa srog phur dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs su grags pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ me 'bar mar 'di dang phal cher zhus dag pher ba la/ 'gor skad shan sbyar med pa sogs mi mthun pa kha shas yod cing*/ de yang dkar chag tu phur bu sgrub pa'i khongs su 'dren pa las logs su mi snang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i phyag dper 'og nas yig phreng gnyis tsam mi gcig de phyin me 'bar ma'i de dang zhus dag pher ba zhig 'dug 'gor bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po chen po'i phur bu'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa gza' skar drag po la zhes yod (mchod rten)(mu)pa'i mgon po phur bu'i sgrub thabs kyi gsal byed me 'bar mar yang bzhugs/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa bla ma'i gsung bzhin bris pa sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang*/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon sku la sdo byed dang*// dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang*// zhes yod (mchod rten)(mu)pa'i nag po chen po srog gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis me 'bar mar yod kyang sgrub thabs dngos gzhi rgya gzhung gi sdebs su sku smad phur bu'i gsal kha yang mi 'dug pas de dang mi gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zur pa zhig yod med dpyad/ 'gor bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal nag po chen po srog gi spu gri sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i gong gi gsal (mchod rten)(mu)byed brtse ba chen pos mdzad pa'i nag po chen po phur bu'i sgrub thabs sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'di la rdzong chung ba dge slong shrī bha dras mdzad pa la sa chen gyis mdzad kyang sbyang gsung yang shrī bha dra zhes pa'i gang zag su yin 'chad rgyu rang gzhan gnyis kar ngos 'dzin rgyu ma byung zhes rdo rje 'chang tshar pa gsung ngo*//

'gor skad shan sbyar dang*/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' lta bus 'jigs byed 'phros// zhes yod pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa la gang zag dbang po 'bring gi khog phub dang brjod bya la dpags na 'di 'bring du 'dren rigs na'ang dkar chag bzhin bkod pa'o// dbang du byas nas las kyi gshin rje pho mo bcu drug lus la bkod de bsgoms pa'i sgrub thabs (mu)gsang ba zhes bya ba gsang sgrub bam phrin las gsang ba'i sgrub thabs su grags pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa ā tsār+ya rā hu la dmar po'i gdams ngag bla ma gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang*/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma la gus sdom pa bsrung*// zhes yod pa'i dbang po tha ma spros pa la dga' ba'i ched du lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa dur khrod nag po dngos bstan gyi sgrub (rdo rje)(mu)thabs rgyas pa 'di la bsnyen pa'i tshul du sgrub pa/ bod pa'i man ngag sgrub pa'i tshul du nyams su blang ba/ rbad pa'i man ngag las sbyor gyi tshul du nyams su blang ba yod ces dkar chag tu gsungs pa ltar don la tshang zhing gsal ba 'og gi bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyis gdams par 'dug go/ nang sgrub tu grags pa nag po chen po'i khyad par gyi cho ga bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa la li ta badz+ra dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i dpal mgon po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo drag byed kyi tshul du zhes yod (rdo rje)pa'i gong gi bsdus don dharma gzi brjid kyis mdzad pa las gzhan bya bar bstan pa'o'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor/ oṃ swa sti/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bskur dam tshig sdom la gnas// zhes yod pa'i dpal (rdo rje)(mu)nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyi gdams pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/

'gor bla ma dang ni yi dam lha// chos skyong mgon la gus btud de// zhes yod pa'i dpal nag po chen po lha bcu bdun ma'i bsnyen sgrub las (mu)gsum gyi yi ge mi bslu ba'i gsang tshig dpal chen skye med jo gdan dang lce rin po che mnyam med mkhyen chen gyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi gru ston gyis mdzad pa/ 'gor/ bla ma khrag 'thung dpa' mor bcas// mchod 'os kun la btud byas te// zhes yod pa'i mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i bod rbad bsad gsum gyi mngon rtogs rgyas (mu)pa sgrub thabs lag tu blang ba'i rim pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che zhes bya ba/ gyi ljang lo tsā ba chen po'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin mdo smad kyi slob ma'i gtso bo tshar dgu ston pa dang gru gu ston pa gnyis kyis bka' bgros nas yi ger bkod pa mngon par rtogs pa nye bar mkho ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ lugs srol 'di'i nyams len la sgrub thabs 'di med kha med snying ltar gces pa'i gdams pa yin pas 'chol bar mi ston pa'i bka' rgya dam po dkar chag tu gsal bar 'dug go /lugs srol 'di nyid kyi snying por gyur pa nag po chen po gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung (mchod rten)('khor lo)ba'i gter zhes bya ba mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rgwa ā nan dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa/ de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i cha lag 'gor bla ma rnams la na mo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// bstan pa bsrung zhing mnga' mdzad pa// zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po lha bcu bdun ma'i mngon par rtogs pa rtags byung nas rtag gtor kyang btang ngo'i mtha' can/ mgon po'i phrin las bka' gsang rmad (mu)byung ma thams cad byang chub tu bsngo'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor/ 'thung zhig 'thung zhig rdo rje'i chu// zhes yod pa'i nag (mu)po chen po'i mchod phreng las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod kyi mtha' can/

'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i nag po chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga (rdo rje)slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor gtor ma'i cho ga 'di la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i gong gi bsdus (rdo rje)don dharma gzi brjid kyis mdzad pa/ 'gor skad shan sbyar yod pa'i dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bram ze (mu)mchog sred kyis mdzad pa zhar byung me lha'i bstod pa gsang gsum ma dang bcas pa/ 'gor sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i gong gi bsdus (rdo rje)don dharma gzi brjid kyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i dpal nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa'i phreng ba (mchod rten)(rdo rje)(mu)bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa la li ta dang lo tsā ba gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba/

kha skong bstod 'bum dang zhabs btags mar yang yod/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na zhal gzigs ma'i bstod pa rnams gsung 'dug pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta snying phreng can dang gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba'i mgon po'i bstod pa rnams la dgongs 'dra ba brgyud pa so sor bgrangs phyin sgyur byed kyi stabs nas bgrangs kyang mi 'gal lo// yang lo paṇa de gnyis kyis bsgyur ba'i dpal nag po chen po la bstod cing phrin las 'chol ba (mchod rten)(rdo rje)sngon tshe bde gshegs ma bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ me 'bar po ti dang tshar lugs bstod 'bum na'ang yod/ 'di'i rjes su nag po chen po'i bsnyen sgrub rbad bsad kyi yi ge rnying pa/ bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga'am bkra shis kyi cho gar grags pa sna tshogs rdo rje ma gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba rnams so// gnyis pa las mgon gyi sgrub thabs la/ 'gor rgya skad yod pa'i mgon po gcer bu'i ngan sngags sam dur khrod kyi mgon po gcer bu'i sgrub thabs (rdo rje)(mu)bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la nang gses sgrub pa las sbyor ser 'bebs dang bcas pa yod cing rang 'dra'i 'khor bzhis bskor ba'i lha lnga dang k+ṣe tra pā la dang pi tā pā la gnyis bsnan pa'i gtso 'khor bdun du 'gyur bas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na lha bdun ma zhes yod/ kha cig gur mgon dpa' gcig dang rdzong chung pa gur mgon nyid du bzhed pa ni sgrub yig rnying par mdun du mgon po'i bka' nyan gyi tshul du bskyed par bshad pa dang sgrub lugs dang sngags sogs gang la'ang the tshom ma zhugs pa'i skyon yin zhing*/ gnod sbyin klu bdag nag po zhes bya ba las mkhan shin tu gnyan pa zhig yin tshul bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras gsung ba sogs dkar chag tu gsal bar yod pa zhib mor dpyod pa gnad du che'o// 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod na gnas pa'i mgon po gcer bu zangs gri can zhes yod pa'i (mchod rten)sgrub thabs gong ma'i yi ge lhag chad dang bral bar bris pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/

me 'bar mar yang bzhugs/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal mgon po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// gtso bo'i nga rgyal sngon song bas zhes yod pa'i bran bdud (mu)(rdo rje)gshin rje nag po'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa gzhan la mi spel bar bka' rgyas btab pa gyi ljang gis bsgyur ba/ 'gor 'di'i lung sbyin pa'i tshul 'dri ste zhes yod pa'i rje sa chen gyis do pa ston tshul la gnang ba'i (mchod rten)(rdo rje)(dung)bran bdud kyi lung sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i rjes gnang gi yi ge ngag 'dzin yi ge la zin bris byas pa'o'i mtha' can/ me 'bar du yang bzhugs/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal nag po chen po'i drag sgrub spyi'i las la zhes yod pa'i (mchod rten)(rdo rje)(dung)bran bdud kyi sgrub thabs dpal brtse ba chen po chos kyi rje'i zhal snga nas kyi rjes su bzung ste rgyal khams pa do pa ston tshul la gtsigs su mdzad de gnang ba/ 'gor bla ma dang dpal ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po lcam dral mchod dang bsten// zhes yod pa'i ru mtshon bca' (mchod rten)(rdo rje)thabs kyi yig rnying yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis zhus dag mdzad pa/ me 'bar mar yang yod/ la la dag bran bdud 'di lugs gzhan zhig tu ngos 'dzin pa dang 'phags pa rin po ches gzigs snang gi mgon po rta nag mar 'dod pa sogs rnam par ma brtags pa kho na ste 'di'i sgrub skor bla ma mal la brtse ba chen pos gser srang gang gis bslus pa'i gtsigs chen yin tshul sogs yig rnying du yod pas kyang shes nus so// bran bdud 'di shin tu bka' gnyan pas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas chig brgyud du gnang ba yang phyag len ma'o// gsum pa las sbyor thor bu'i yi ge la/ dpal nag po chen po dang las byed rdo rje mong spu can gyi sgo nas ser ba dbab pa'i yi ge mgon po'i ser ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/

'gor gzhan yang ser ba dbab pa dang*/ zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom zer ba yod pa'i gong gi gsal byed kyi yi ge gzhan rnams gzhung na gsal lo'i mtha' can/ 'gor gzhan yang man ngag 'di lta ste zhes yod pa'i rbod gtong bzlog pa'i man ngag mthar ni byang shar mtshams su mnan zhes pa'i mtha' can/ nag po chen po'i rgyud las rdo rje'i tshig tu sbas nas gsungs pa'i man ngag (rdo rje)(mu)brgyad ces pa dregs byed thams cad gnon par byed pa/ bgegs thams cad rlag par byed pa/ char dbab pa/ char gcad pa/ yi dwags bskrad pa/ phyag rgya ma 'gugs pa/ rgyal po la sogs pa dbang du bya ba/ rig sngags rbod gtong gcod pa rnams so// lnga pa dkar chag tu ma 'khod pa'i yi ge la/ rdzong chung pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i (mu)dkar chag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses dpal bde gsal gyi mgon khang du (zha)mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs khyab bdag sku bzhi ma/ 'gor bla ma la na mo/ nag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang zhes yod pa'i mgon po lha bcu bdun (mchod rten)ma'i dbang gi tho yig rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin bris so'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor dpal rdo rje 'chang dbang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor du zhes yod pa'i gyi ljang (mchod rten)lugs kyi dbang gi lag len nyi shu dgu'i dgongs mo bka' gnang ba shin tu gal che gsung ba'i mtha' can/ mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub yig paṇa chen byams pa gling pas mdzad pa rnams legs par thob bo// bdun pa 'dod khams dbang phyug khrag 'thung dud pa'i sol ba can gyi skor la/ de yang dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma la rje khol gnyis su grags pa'i dud pa'i sol ba can 'di rje mo re ma tī yin zhing*/ gur mgon gyi skabs mgon po lcam dral gnyis su grags na'ang sa skya pa'i lugs la rjes gnang zur pa med cing sgrub thabs la tshogs bdag

bka' sdod/ phyi pa/ nang pa ltar sgrub tshul yod kyang man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa med par brten/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes yum bka'i skor gyi rjes gnang man ngag tshang ba zhig thugs la bzhed nas/ tshul de sa lugs dwags brgyud pa sogs gang du'ang ma rnyed par rim gyis rtsad gcod gnang bas chu mgo gangs dkar gyi dpe bzhin/ rje mar pas/ dud sol lha mo ma gtogs pa'i// bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad zhus// zhes gsungs pa ltar shin tu gces spras su mdzad pa'i lha mo'i skor 'di spyir dpal nā ro pa la bstan srung brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa'i khrod nas gtor ma dngos su len pa'i chos skyong gsum yod pa'i nang nas gdam nga 'di la mdzad pas rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig lo gsum bal po'i mthil du bsdad// rje byin rlabs can gyi bal po la// rgyud gnyan por grags pa'i gdan bzhi zhus// chos skyong dud sol lha mo zhus// zhes bal po pham mthing pa spyi ther ba las kyang gsan cing rje mar pa la slob ma'i gtso bo ka chen bzhi'i nang gi rngog chos kyi rdo rjes lo tsā ba'i chos skyong gi gtso bor dud sol ma/ kaṃ ka rtsal/ thod phreng can gsum zhus pas gsum ga mi yong 'dam btang bar kye rdor dang gdan bzhi sogs rgyud mang po'i bka' srung du 'dug pa dang bla ma yang thugs gtsigs che bar 'dug pa sogs nas 'dod khams ma 'dams te rdzogs par gsan/ de nas rngog tshang 'og mar grags pa'i rngog ston chen po bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyi bar du rigs dang chos kyi brgyud pa zam ma chad pa'i nges shes kyi gnas chen por gyur te rjes gnang sgrub skor dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ phyogs der bla ma'i sku srog la bsdo ba'i bsgral bya'i zhing zhig 'dug pa chos bka' rnams rdzogs par gnang ba'i bka' drin gsob ched du chos skyong 'di'i sgo nas gtor ma la brten pa'i las sbyor mdzad pas ring por ma lon par rjes med du gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar yid ches dang ldan pa'i chos skor la/

dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma 'jigs byed dud pa'i sol ba can gyi chos skor gyi dkar chag snyan brgyud gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa/ de las bstan pa'i gdams pa la/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo'i sgo nas gtor ma'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i lha mo phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge rngog zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'di nyid kyi lag len gsal byed rngog bsod nams don grub kyis gzhung ri bo khyung lding gi chos grwar mdzad pa ni dpe ma 'byor pas ma thob/ 'gor lha mo chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po rten rdzas thams cad tshogs par byas la zhes yod pa'i lha mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa nan chags mar grags pa'i rtsa ba'i yi ge rngog zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de'i gsal byed mar rngog gi phyag len zhes pa'i gsang sgrub rjes gnang gi yi ge mkhas pa'i dbang po blo gsal rgya mtshos bskul ba la brten nas rngog bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyis stod lung mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/ ma mo spyi'i rgyud dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ma'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa au ḍ+yān gyi gnas chen por mkha' 'gro ma ḍom+bi ka ma la'i zhal snga nas dang sgyur byed kyi lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dud sol ma'i sgos rgyud dpal lha mo nag mo dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po nā ro pa dang bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+de lo ka shrīs bsgyur ba/ yang lo paṇa de gnyis kyis bsgyur ba'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma phyi sgrub kyi rgya gzhung zhes pa bsnyen pa/ smyo zhing bsad pa/ bsam gtan gyis gsod pa rnams ston pa'i mkha' 'gro dud sol ma'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/

'di dang me 'bar ma'i phyi pa ltar sgrub pa gnyis khyad par med ces dkar chag tu gsung pa ltar zhus dag kyang pher ba 'dug go/ de'i bsdus don sa bcad 'gor/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'di sgrub pa la don bzhi ste zhes yod pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ bsnyen pa la don bco lnga/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor/ smyo zhing bsad pa la don lnga/ don lnga zer yang rdzas bsags pa nas sbyin sreg gi bar brgyad 'dug go/ bskyar ba'i cho ga dang bcas pa'i lag len shin tu zab cing gsal ba rgya gzhung gi 'grel pa zhal gdams mar grags pa zhag bdun du ci yang mi za bar byed do des nges par 'grub bo'i mtha' can/ snyan brgyud po tir bzhugs pa'i yig chung yid bzhin nor bu dang zhus dag pher zhes dkar chag na snang ngo*// 'gor dpa' bo chu skyes sngon po'i mdog ces yod pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rje mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi gsung las byung ba bla ma'i zhal nas gsung ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dam tshig ldan pa'i sngags pa yis// zhes yod pa'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi zhal gdams shin tu zab pas gsang bar bya zhes pa'i mtha' can/ mar pas nā ro pa la chos skyong zhus pa'i lo rgyus yod pa'i lha bskyed/ bzlas pa/ rmi ltas/ srog thun sum cu'i rno tshad/ bzlas pa'i skyon yon/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor/ sbyin sreg gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la brten tshul/ bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags byang*/ gtor ma dang ling ga bltab tshul rnams chos sde gcig tu bzhugs pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i zhal gdams rngog gzhung pa yab sras la gnang ba/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i zhal gdams bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge zhes pa 'dug 'gor ma hā de wī na mo/ gzhan yang bdag gi rmi ltas su zhes yod pa'i sgrub pa las sbyor gyi yi ge zhal gdams rmi ltas mar grags pa dpal ldan lha mo'i rmi ltas rdzogs so'i mtha' can/

'dod khams dbang phyug dud sol ma'i gsang sgrub kyi rgya gzhung rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po nā ro pas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ yig cha'i kha yig na bir+wa pas mdzad zer ba 'dug pa 'khrul gzhi byung ba ste 'di dur khrod dga' ba'i tshal du rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa la lha mos dngos su gnang nas shar phyogs nag po las brgyud pa yin gyi yig cha 'di ga mdzad pa ni min no// de'i 'grel pa'i lag len ma 'dod khams dbang phyug drag mo rkang thang ma rno ba'i mde'u ha la reg chod ces bya ba zhe sdang rdo rjes yi ger bris pa/ 'gor dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo sgrub pa'i thabs la gru gsum steng du zhes yod pa'i drag mo rkang thang gi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ drag mo rkang thang yang snying bkol ba'i sgrub thabs dud sol ma mngon sum du bkol ba'i man ngag tu grags pa rngog zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'gor dpal khrag 'thung gi rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod sol ba can gyi sgrub thabs ni zhes yod pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug yang gsang rkang thang du sgrub pa'i yi ge rngog zhe sdang rdo rje'i zhal gdams ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa'i mtha' can/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed pa'i las sbyor gyi yi ge longs spyod thams cad lha'i dbang po dang mnyam mo'i mtha' can/ la cha'i sdig par brten nas ma mo rang gi lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs pa'i rten gyi yi ge dpal ldan lha mo'i sgo nas dgra la ltas ngan dbab pa'i thabs bstan pa'i yi ge rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dpal ldan lha mo'i mngon par shes pa sgrub pa'i lag len gnad dbab dang bcas pa slob dpon chen po zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gong ma 'di la pra rten gyi khye'u sogs 'dug pa dang 'og ma 'dir khye'u med pa'i me long sogs la brten pa'i mo yin pa'i brjod bya 'dug pa nas gong 'og gi ming nor ba yin min som nyir snang ngo*//

dpal ldan lha mo'i sgo nas pra dbab pa spyan 'dren ma gcig lha mo ma dang bcas pa/ gri snying sogs la brten nas mngon shes bsgrub pa/ dkar chag na 'di logs su med la zhal gdams dang bcas zer ba'i zhal gdams yin nam snyam/ spyan 'dren thod pa dgu brtsegs 'phrul gzhal ma rgyal tsha rdo rje sems dpas mdzad pa/ mchod 'bul/ khyed la gtsang dme'i rtog pa mi mnga' ma/ gzhan yang mchod 'bum ma/ gtor bskang ban+dha lcang lo ma/ thugs dam bskang zhing phrin las bskul ba/ bdag ni rig 'dzin ma rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gtor gshegs dpal ldan ma/ gtor gshegs bzlog bsgyur dang bcas pa rdo rje gar dbang ma/ bstan ma skyong ba/ bka' yi tshogs bcas ma rnams dud sol gtor chog gi lhan thabs skabs nye bar mkho ba/ bstod snying*/ sems nyid phrin las ma/

zhabs btags mar yang yod/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dge ba bcu'i sgo nas bstod pa/ sngon 'das bskal pa ma/ tshig zur tsam ma gtogs rags rim zhus dag pher ba me 'bar mar yang bzhugs/ phyogs bcu'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bskul ba/ ma mo'i gtso bo ma/ 'dod khams dbang phyug khrag 'thung dud sol ma'i phrin las kyi las byang rgyas pa ḍā ki ma'i thugs kyi ze'u 'bru dbye bar byed pa'i man ngag rgya mtsho gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba sngags 'chang ā nan+da dh+wa dza dang btsun pa kye rdo rje shrī badz+ra gnyis kyis ngan rtog spangs nas rgyud sgrub thabs rnams dang mthun par bsgrigs pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi smin grol rjes gnang nyams khrid lung man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas pa'i sgo nas legs par thob pa'i dang po rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i nag po chen po dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ grub dbang shar phyogs nag po pa/ rgyal rigs ḍā ma ru pa/ gnyis spangs a wa dhū tī pa/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ thugs sras se mkhar chung pa/ bla ma zhang ston chos 'bar/ brtse chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ zhabs drung a mi lags yab sras/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/

mtshungs med kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan po rin po che sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngor chen la mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gung ru shes rab bzang po bzhis gsan/ de bzhi char las kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ de las yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba dang*/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gsan pa man 'dra'o// bka' babs gnyis pa ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i mgon po dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa a shwa ka shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ rje btsun sa skya pa kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ mkhas pa gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje btsun lha mchog seṅge/ rje sangs rgyas seṅge/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med shes bya bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis thob bo// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ mkhas grub dpal rdor ba/ dkon mchog 'phel ba man snga ma dang 'dra'o// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ rje rat+na war+dha man 'dra/ 'di'i sgrub skor kha skong po ti'i mchod rten dang e rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni ngor chen nas/

mus chen/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// mchod rten dang bud+dha'i rtags can gyi lung ni/ ngor chen nas/ mus chen/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun spangs chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man gong dang 'dra'o// bka' babs bzhi pa kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i spu gri skor gsum ga dang lhan cig pa'i mchod rten gyi rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred nas rim par kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dge slong zla ba rgyal kye rdor zhal lan gsum gzigs par grags/ mtshan/ bla ma khams pa/ ri pa dge tshul/ 'di rnams kyis chos skyong lan lnga re gzigs skad/ dar ma dpal/ rim bzhin yab chos rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar ro// e rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ dar ma dpal nas rim bzhin/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man gong ngor lugs bzhin no// bka' babs gsum pa'i gri gug lha lnga/ lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi rgya gzhung lugs kyi dbang rdo rje dang g.yung drung can gyi lung bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/

nor bu gling pa/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ bla ma brag steng pa/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ bkras lung pa nam mkha' bsod nams/ dge sdings pa chen po/ rje sangs rgyas dpal ba/ rin chen gling pa/ dkar shongs pa rin chen rdo rje/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rdzong chung pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa'ang zer dbang lnga po'i dkyil chog mdzad po de yin/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ jo gdan khrom yon yang zer/ brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ rje rdo rje gdan pa/ de las klu dbang gling pa gnas kyi ming yin zhing yongs grags la thugs sras zer/ kun dga' rgyal po dang*/ lcang lo can pa bsod nams mchog ldan gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis las rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras sngags 'chang bsod nams dbang phyug de yi sras sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan po mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa chen po bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ shar pa ye shes chen po/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dol po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/

mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ theg chen chos rje man 'dra/ lha brgyad rgya gzhung lugs kyi dbang brgyud gcig la/ rdo rje gdan pa nas/ yangs pa can pa byang chub dbang rgyal/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis man gong dang 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen dol bu/ mkhan chen byang sems pa/ theg chen pa man 'dra/ gri gug lha lnga rgya gzhung lugs kho na'i dbang brgyud gcig la/ 'phags pa rin po che nas/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rje kun dga' rnam rgyal man 'dra'o// yang gri gug lha lnga'i dbang dang lha bcu gnyis ma bcu bdun ma rnams thun mong gi dbang brgyud lugs gcig la/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ bla brang pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rje ye shes dpal bzang*/ rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ yang lha bcu gnyis ma'i brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ shrad+dhā ka ra nas/ jo bo rje/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ dge tshul pūr+ṇa ba/ rgya lcags ri gong pa/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/ spen phug pa dar ma shākya/ zhang ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ze ba don grub ye shes/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ bar thang chos grags/ bla ma dar ma shākya bsod nams dbang phyug gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa ta dben chen po/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims brtan pa/ byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ yang na bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma mchog ldan/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rdo rje/ mkhan chen dbang phyug seṅge/

nam mkha' ye shes/ de gsum las theg chen chos rjes gsan/ de nas 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal man 'dra'o// rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po gri gug lha lnga sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du snyan brgyud lugs kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a naṅga badz+ra/ pad+ma badz+ra/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ phun tshogs bde ba/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra/ bla chen 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung ba/ zhang ston rol pa'i rdo rje zhes lak+ṣ+mī'i gsan yig tu byung*/ chos 'bar/ rje brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ mthu chen ā nan dam pa/ rong mi ye shes/ kre bo rdo rje grags/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ rje btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal/ 'jigs med dpa' bo yang zer/ klu dbang gling pa kun dga' rgyal po/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras sngags 'chang bsod nams dbang phyug de sras sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/

des bdag la'o// gyi ljang lugs kyi mgon po gshin rje ltar sgrub pa lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa mtha' brten sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bzlas lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ grub chen nag po ro 'dzin/ lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ tshar dgu ston pa/ grub thob bsod 'di rmor gyi la ma byung nams grags/ mon mig dmar ston pa/ bla chen ra lam pa/ bla ma zhang ston pa/ long gro byang chub dar/ de las lce mdo sde dang*/ dpal chen skye med/ jo gdan gsum gyis zhus/ de gsum ka las grub ston shākya 'bum/ dge bshes dbugs/ sa skya pa dharma gzi brjid/ nyi thog pa sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba/ 'dar yar 'dren mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal bzang*/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rje kun dga' rnam rgyal/ thugs sras klu dbang gling pa man 'dra/ yang na grub ston shākya 'bum/ de la dkar gshongs pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang bdag po bsod nams yon tan pas gsan/ de gnyis las bla chen chos dpal bzang pos gsan/ de nas lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī dzñā na/ rje mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ rje klu dbang gling pa man 'dra'o// yang na tshar chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa kun dga' bkra shis man sngar dang 'dra'o// yang dbang rkyang pa'i brgyud lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha lo chen rin chen bzang po/ dge tshul pūr+ṇa/ rgya lcags ri gong kha ba/ rdzing bu kha ba shākya grags/ spen phug pa dar ma shākya/ zhang ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gze pa don grub ye shes/

khams pa sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ 'di gnyis la bar thang pa yab sras zer/ bar thang pa chos grags/ slob dpon dar ma shākya/ spur ston bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma mchog ldan pa/ skyi ston pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin chen rdo rje/ mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ mkhan chen nam mkha' ye shes/ de gsum ga las theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos gsan/ de nas rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ mus srad pa man sin+dhū ra'i dbang dang 'dra/ yang na skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dol po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ theg chen pa man 'dra/ yang na spur bsod nams dbang phyug nas/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ ta dben chen po/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims brtan pa/ byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ rje kun dga' rnam rgyal man 'dra'o// rjes gnang skor la/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha gsum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ gu rub

lo rgyus na go rub pa rin chen bsod nams zhes pa 'di sku tshe'i stod rab byung gi mtshan dang sku tshe'i smad la dkar chas su gyur pa'i mtshan brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims zhes grags pas tha dad du mi bzhed do// rin chen bsod nams/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge/ brang ti pa paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub shākya kun dga'/ mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// brgyud tshul 'di ni paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsan yig las de ltar 'byung la/ zhabs drung rgyal rtse bas shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas la'ang gsan 'dug ces gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por 'byung*/ 'dir ni 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i rjes su dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje rdo ring pa/ rje blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras gnyis ka las mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan dang*/

mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags gnyis kyis gsan/ phyi ma las sa skya bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams/ rgyal mkhar rtse pa ngag dbang bsod nams/ rje ri khrod pa kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na/ mus chen sangs rin nas/ mus chen nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje btsun chos dbang*/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sa skya pa a mi'i drung ngo*// rje thar rtse nas/ sngags 'chang blo gros/ de la'ang a mi'i drung gis so// yig cha ni thog mar mal los tho tsam mdzad/ de rjes 'phags pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha yod la/ 'dir paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gur gyi mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma sbags te sgrub pa'i rjes gnang gi yig cha'i steng nas tho yig gis 'dor len mdzad pa'i sgo nas so// yang gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad ngor lugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che yan gong ltar las/ de nas zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seṅge/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seṅge/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub shākya kun dga'/ mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la yang yang stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/

des bdag la lan du ma'i bar du stsal to// mgon po lha bcu gnyis kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan gong ltar las/ de nas dam pa kun dga' grags/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ gzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen/ bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā/ rje btsun dkon mchog grags pa/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ grub mchog rdo rje'i mtshan can/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ byams pa bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dbang phyug bka' drin can bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin stsal to// yang na rje shes rab rgyal mtshan nas/ brang ti pa paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'di'i bar nas bla ma kha cig btsal dgos so// de nas chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ rje ri khrod pa bud+dha sā ga ra/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// lha bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ dam pa kun dga' grags yan gong ltar las/ de nas dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen gzhi thog pa/ bdag chen kun dga' rin chen/ bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug drung btsun rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje man gong dang 'dra'o// lcam dral lha gsum thun mong ma yin pa dang*/

lha brgyad thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ lha bcu gnyis thun mong dang thun mong ma yin par dbye ba'i rjes gnang bzhi dang bcas pa rgwa ā nan dam pa tsam ma gtogs gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud du byon pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ paṇa chen dad byed go cha/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags pa/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis kas mdo khams kyi khrom gseb tu mgon por gzigs pas sprul par yang grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ mkhas btsun nam ngor lugs kyi gsan yig 'gar nam mkha' legs pa 'di med pa'ang byung*/ mkha' legs pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ yab rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras gnyis ka las mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan dang*/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' chos kyi rje bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan yan zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar las/

de nas sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ thugs sras bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rwa lo gnyis pa dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas mchog pa/ mtshungs med skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ grub mchog bkra shis seṅge/ lcags mo bkra shis seṅge yang zer/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ mkhas btsun sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ de las mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po dang*/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis mnos so// yang na 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ de las shī la rin chen bdag gis mnos so// yang na mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nas/ thub bstan mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ a mi lags kyi drung man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na ngag dbang chos grags nas rgyal rtse pa man 'dra/ gur gyi mgon po gsang sgrub lha dgu'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba'i yang gsang rje tshar chen yan snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs pa la/ tshar chen gyis tho tsam mdzad pa dbang phyug rab brtan gyis tshig sna cung zad bsrings ba kha byang rgya skad yod pa'i steng ngam mkhan chen ngag chos pas mdzad pa gang rung gi steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po yan khro bcu ltar las/

de nas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nas/ rje btsun bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ yongs 'dzin ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen kun dga' tshul khrims/ chos rje bud+dha shrī bha dra/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang chen po bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma bsrung zlog bsad gsum gyi phyi khrid/ nang khrid drag po sngags rgod kyi gsang khrid gnyug ma ye shes kyi rtsal 'don rnams kyi khrid zhib tu thob cing*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa yan sngar dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas mthu chen ā nan dam pa/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun kun spangs chen po/ mkhas grub blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje btsun bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ khams ston bkra shis dpal ldan/ khams ston sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la nyams khrid zab mo smin rgyas su 'khor lo mdo'i pho brang gi ba gam gsum par legs par stsal to// yang kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha dgu rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten nas bsgrub pa'i gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu zhal shes snyan brgyud kyi khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje yan gong ltar las/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ he ru ka dpal ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len dang*/ nang 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i las sbyor/ khrid rje mkhyen brtse pas mdzad pa'i steng nas mdzad cing lung yang thos so// tshe sgrub kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje bla ma dam pa nas/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje bsod nams dbang phyug rje btsun rdo ring pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra'o// yang khrid yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ tshar chen yab sras gnyis nas sngags 'chang sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// brgyud pa 'di las 'ongs pa'i lcam dral lha gsum/ lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis ma rnams kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang so sor thob bo// de dag gi rgyab brten lung gi skor la/ lha/ rgya/ sdings/ yar gyi rtags yod pa rnams ma gtogs pa'i me 'bar ma dang kha skong gnyis kyi mchod rten gyi rtags can rnams dang*/ gya/ ngag sa/ lo'i rtags can rnams ma gtogs pa'i snyan brgyud po ti'i rtags yod med yongs rdzogs kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ pho rkyang gi thog ma'i brgyud rim du/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ mchog sred ces sgo rum dpe khang gi sa chen gyi phyag bris ngo ma bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis rnyed pa las byung ngo*// rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje nas/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug

mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man 'dra/ yang me 'bar ma'i phyi'i chos skor nang sgrub kyi yi ge lnga/ gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge bdun dang bcas pa'i lung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig la tshar chen dang*/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs gnyis ka las/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man gong bzhin no// rdo rje'i rtags can rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mchog brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa man gong bzhin no// rdo rje dpal be'u can gyi lung brgyud ni/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan blo gros/ dmar chos kyi rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa/ rje btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal man 'dra'o// ru rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ grub chen bram ze mchog sred/ la li ta badz+ra/ nag po ro 'dzin/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ gshen rdo rje seṅge/ 'brom rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sgom rin chen seṅge/ seṅge dpal/ chos kyi rin chen/ dmar bsod nams 'phel/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ bag ston/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ rin chen 'phel/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra de ba/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seṅge/ 'gos ston rdo rje seṅge/ bla chen nam mkha' gzi brjid/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug drung kun dga' legs pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/

de man chad snga ma dang 'dra ba nyid do// sa rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub man 'dra/ yang ngag gi rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel nas/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen zhwa lu pa man 'dra/ lo rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje yan gong ltar las/ de nas bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams man 'dra'o// yang gyi ljang lugs kyi mgon po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ la li ta badz+ra/ grub thob nag po ro 'dzin/ lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ tshar dgu ston pa/ gru gu ston pa/ dge bshes dbugs/ sa skya pa dge slong dharmā gzi brjid/ nyi thog pa sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba/ mdar mkhan po blo gsal rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ thugs sras klu dbang gling pa/ drin chen tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man gong dang 'dra'o// yang na bram ze mchog sred nas/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ku ku ri pa/ la li ta badz+ra/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ gru gu ston pa/
