mon mig dmar ston pa/ ra lam ston pa/ mgon po jo zhang*/ lang 'gro byang chub dar/ lce ston mdo sde seṅge/ gru ston shāka 'bum/ dkar gshongs pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ stag tshang lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī/ rtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal dpal bzang*/ thugs sras klu dbang gling pa man 'dra'o// yang na gru ston shāka 'bum nas/ bdag po bsod nams yon tan/ mnga' ris bla chen man 'dra/ yang na bram ze chen po nas/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ dge tshul pur+ṇa/ rgya lcags ri gong kha ba/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/ spen phug pa dar ma shākya/ zhang ston ye shes/ bze pa don grub/ bar thang pa yab sras/ slob dpon dar shāka spur bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma mchog ldan/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin chen rdo rje/ mkhan chen nam mkha' ye shes/ mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ phyi ma gsum char las theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rdzong chung pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ rtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// yang na skyi ston/ dol bu kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ theg chen pa man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ nag po ro 'dzin/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ mal lo blo gros grags pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seṅge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rje tshul khrims pa/ tshar pa rdo rje 'chang man 'dra'o// kha skong po ti'i mu g.yung drung can gyi brgyud pa'ang 'di nyid do// me 'bar/ kha skong*/ snyan brgyud gsum gyi chos skor gter byon gyi brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ 'dis rdo rje gdan gyi ka ba la gter du sbas/ de nas dpal au ḍ+yān chen po pad+ma badz+ra gyis spyan drangs nas rgya gar shar phyogs dharma pā lar gnang*/ des ti se dang mtsho ma dros pa gzigs pa'i ched du byon pas lo tsā ba chen po mjal bar gdams pa rnams gnang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po man gong bzhin no// me 'bar po ti'i phyi sgrub yig sna brgya dang nyi shu'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ yab 'jam dbyangs chen po nas/ gcen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ yab sras gnyis ka las gcung bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ de las rdo ring rin po che dang mkhan chen rat+na shī las gsan/ gsum ka las rje btsun sgo rum pa/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na tshar pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ rje bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rab 'byams chos rje kun dga' lhun grub/

chos sku rdo rje yang zer/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub man 'dra'o// rgya rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ gter ston rgya pad+ma dbang phyug lho pa ston nyi/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seṅge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang phyi khrid nang khrid/ de las 'phros pa'i yi ge me 'bar dkar chag gi gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge mchod rten gyi rtags can rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan nas/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man 'dra/ bran bdud kyi chos tshan gsum gyi lung ni/ sa chen nas/ zhang mnga' ris pa/ dge gnyan sras mchog mgon po/ dol po 'byung gnas pa/ bla ma mgon pa rgya/ do pa ston tshul man 'dra'o// yar gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po nas/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seṅge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog yab rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ slob dpon dpal ldan rgyal po/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man mchod rten gyi rtags can dang 'dra/ sdings rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ dam pa kun dga' grags nas/ bla ma rdo rje dpal/ mtshungs med bkra shis dngos grub/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bar sdings pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/

yab chos rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man zhal ngo nang brgyud bzhin no// dkar chag tu ma 'khod pa'i yi ge sa bcad bcu gsum po'i lung brgyud ni mchod rten gyi rtags can rnams dang mthun no// dud sol ma phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ lus med ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ zhu chos sdings pa/ sha sgang pa/ gnyags ston chen po/ gnyags dge bshes mus pa/ mdo sde grags/ slob dpon jo ye/ gnyags gnas gsar ba/ gle lung jo sras ma gcig dgon chung ma/ mus chen rgyal mtshan bzang po/ gug shrī rin po che/ smon lam rdo rje/ bsod nams blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sngags 'chang mchog rgyal ba/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na ngag dbang chos grags nas/ sangs rgyas seṅge/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mchog legs rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze sa ra ha/ mgon po klu sgrub/ ḍā ki ma bskal pa bzang mo/ slob dpon lwa ba pa/ de bzhi ka las tai lo pas gsan pa man 'dra/ gsang sgrub rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa nan chags mar grags pa dang chos skor gyi lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rngog chos sku rdo rje nas/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje/ rngog thogs med grags/ rgyal tsha ra mo/ rngog kun dga' rdo rje/ rngog gzi brjid grags/ rngog rin chen bzang po/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rngog don grub dpal/ rngog byang chub dpal/ rngog khra tshang pa bsod nams don grub/ rngog shākya don grub/ rngog thar gling pa bsod nams lhun po/ de sras rngog bsod nams bstan 'dzin/

rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// phyi'i las mkhan gcer bu zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar las/ de nas do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seṅge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ gcen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum 'bum byams pa chos kyi don grub/ pa/ mkhas pa rat+na chos rje tshul khrims pa'ang zer/ shī la/ rje sgo rum pa/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras gnyis ka nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ de las rje bslab gsum dang rta rwa ba gnyis kas gsan/ yab sras bzhi ka las rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na rje sa chen nas/ yar sgom se bo/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun sa chen nas/ 'gos ston tshar sgang pa/ dge bshes mi g.yo ba/ gshen sgom bla ma dpal/ slob dpon shes rab bla ma/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun sa paṇa nas/ mdo khams kyi rta rge bla ma/ slob dpon shes rab bla ma man 'dra/ lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ku ku ri pa/ nag po ro 'dzin/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen man 'dra/ nang gi las mkhan ber nag zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/

'gos ston tshar sgang pa dang*/ rta rge bla ma yod pa sor gnas kyi/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang man chad sngar dang 'dra'o// gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra ming sring phyi nor srung gnod sbyin pho mo'i tshul dang*/ nang bsad pa gshin rje pho mo'i tshul du sgrub pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ paṇa grub dharma pā la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ de las mal lo tsā ba dang*/ 'brom jo sras zhang dge gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rgwa ā nan dam pa/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ grub chen sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal ldan bkra shis/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang bzang po rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun bsod nams dbang phyug bka' drin can rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dbang phyug sde dge lhun grub steng pa/ khams sde dge lhun grub steng pa/

ston rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul rin la'o// yang rjes gnang dang lha'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud la rgya gar gyi gter ma dang*/ bod kyi gter ma gnyis las dang po ni/ bla ma dam pa yan rjes gnang dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun spangs pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang rjes gnang rkyang pa'i brgyud lugs gcig la/ bla ma dam pa yan sngar ltar las/ de nas bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seṅge/ mkhas grub nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ drin chen mkhyen rab bla ma man 'dra'o// yang na ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab rje/ rat+na war+dha/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// bod kyi gter ma'i brgyud pa ltar na/ dpal au ḍ+yān gyi slob dpon chen po nas/ jo mo mkhar chen bza'/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po man sngar ltar ro// ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i rjes gnang thun mong ba'i brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan gong zhal ngo nang brgyud ltar las/ de nas do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seṅge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/

tshem bu pa dpal ldan blo gros/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ dpal kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ti'u ra pa chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ gcung 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ dpon slob kun dga' dpal 'byor/ 'di nas bla ma gnyis tsam btsal dgos/ thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ ku ku ri pa/ dur khrod nag po ro 'dzin/ gyi ljang lo tsā ba dbu dkar/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ rgyal khams pa do pa ston tshul man 'dra/ yang na sa chen nas zhang mnga' ris pa/ dge bsnyen sras mchog mgon po/ dol po 'byung gnas pa/ rgya sgom tshul khrims grags/ do pa ston tshul man 'dra'o// de yang gong gi rtsa ba'i rtags bzhi rgyag pa'i dgos pa ni/ ji skad du/ de dag las 'ongs so so'i ngos 'dzin ni// ngor lugs yi ge e yi rtags kyis mtshan// rdo rje gdan pa las byung rdo rje'i rgya// mus srad pa ni yi ge mu yi rgya// bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dbang las brgyud pa'i// rtsa ba'i yi ge mchod rten rgya yis mdzes// thor bu gzhan dag mchan bu btab pas shes// zhes gsungs pa ltar rtogs par bya zhing gong du ngos ma zin pa'i me 'bar kha skong gi ljang gsum la rtags med pa 'ga' zhig byung ba rnams mchan bu 'grol rgyu yi ge ngos ma ma mthong bas re zhig dpyad par bya'o// smras pa/ phyi rol snang ba'i dregs pa rgyud gsum po// rang sems gdod ma'i mgon por ngo sprod pa// bka' babs rnam bzhi'i dbang dang byin rlabs khrid// rgyab brten glegs bam phal cher lung du mnos// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/

gser chos rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste nyer bzhi pa'o// //rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan par rtag 'go zhing*// rgyal gsung gsang mdzod bsrung ba'i g.yar dam mdud// mi shigs dam can yongs kyi sde dpon che// zhing skyong gdong bzhi ldan pa'i chos skor la// de yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa brgyud le'u bcu bdun pa las/ drag po mi sdug khros pa ni// ut+pal sngon po'i kha dog 'dra// phyag bzhi pa ni cho ga yis// phyag na thod pa bsnams par bsgom// zhes dngos su bstan cing*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad rgyud las kyang gsal bar bstan pa'i stobs 'phrog nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'am drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug tu grags pa 'di nyid ni/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes/ de ltar rgyal ba'i dri med rgyud sde las// gsungs pa'i bstan srung kun gyi mchog gyur pa// drag shul mthu ldan stobs 'phrog nag po zhes// rgya bod mkhas grub kun la rlung ltar grags// zhes gsungs pa ltar 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal mgon klu sgrub zhabs/ bsod snyoms pa chen po ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku sa li chen mo sogs paṇa grub du mas chos skyong gi gtso bor mdzad cing*/ bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis gdan drangs pa'i bstan srung brgya rtsa tsam gyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa bzung*/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs bstan pa srung ba'i mtshon char mgon po che chung gnyis su dbye ba'i chung bar grags shing shin tu rtsub 'gyur che zhing gnyan pas bka' dam par mdzad/ khyad par sbas pa'i mgon po la rigs mang du yod pa'i nang nas sbas pa'i mgon po'am dam tshig gi mgon po yin pas zhal bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur sogs kyang mi bzhed zhing*/

re gnyis byung ba dag kyang khyab gdal du ye mi ston pa gnad kyi gdams pa yin gyi/ deng sang 'di'i sku 'dri ba dang ston pa sogs bag med du byed pa rnams ni 'di dag rna bas ma thos shing 'tshub 'gyur mi 'byung ba sogs kyang chos skyong ye ma 'khor ba'i rtags so// des na dam tshig che phra kun la gces par mdzad pa smin grol gdams pa'i gnad mtha' dag ma nyams pa snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba/ thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab byar snyan brgyud dang po byin rlabs dang rjes gnang*/ gnyis pa gdams pa dngos/ gsum pa bla ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong longs spyod kyis mnyes par byas pa la brten nas snyan brgyud bzhi pa'i rten 'brel shugs las 'grig pa'am/ yang na tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis/ de yang thog mar tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*// rin chen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa// snyan brgyud dang po'i rten 'brel kun bsgrigs nas// snyan brgyud gnyis pa byin rlabs rjes gnang sbyin// snyan brgyud gsum pa gdams pa'i dngos gzhi 'di// bklag lung min par lag len dmar khrid du// byin pas snyan brgyud bzhi pa shugs las 'byung*// zhes pa ltar rdo rje slob dpon mnyes pa dngos grub kyi rtsa ba dang*/ shin tu bka' gnyan pa'i zab chos rnams la dpon slob gnyis kas tshogs dang bskang bshags sogs kyi sgo nas mkha' 'gro srung ma rnams kyi nyams chag skong zhing bka' rgya bkrol te gnang ba zhu ba ma byas na 'phral du 'tshub cing mthar mi shis pa la sogs pa 'byung bas lha 'dod yon la longs spyod pa lta bu'i snyan brgyud dang por byas te/ gnyis pa chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun lta bu/ gsum pa gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu/ bzhi pa chos la yid ches kyi mos gus rnyed pa gzhon nu'i dga' ba lta bu'i go rim ste/ de yang bshad tshul gnyis po gang byas kyang go rims tsam las don la khyad med na'ang phyi ma'i rjes su 'brangs te snyan brgyud dang po'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa sngon du 'gro ba byas nas/

snyan brgyud gnyis pa rjes gnang dang gsum pa gdams pa'i dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang pas mdzad pa'i gnyan mgon chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas sam/ gnyan lo'i gnad yig dang dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyi yi ge dang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dngos grub rgya mtsho dang brgyud pa'i phyag len la brten nas bsnyen dus kyi mgon po'i rjes

1 gnang*/ pho nya myur mgyogs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge gong ma rnams la brten nas sgrub dus thun mong ba'i rjes 2 gnang*/ yi ge de gnyis dang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i bka' rgya ma la sogs pa la brten nas sgrub dus kyi rjes 3 gnang thun mong ma yin pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge gong ma dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag len dbri snon ltar las sbyor gyi mgon po'am paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa lugs kyi dpal mgon gdong brnyan can du grags pa'i rjes 4 gnang*/ dngos grub rgya mtsho dang gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang phyag len gsung rgyun ltar gsang khrid kyi rjes 5 gnang*/ las bzhi'i rjes gnang la mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'am 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i yi ge la brten nas dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes 6 gnang*/ dkar chag na bzhugs pa'i las bzhi'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi yig chung dngos grub rgya mtsho/ gsung rgyun phyag len ltar g.yas zhal dkar po las byung ba'i dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ba'i rjes 7 gnang*/ steng zhal dud kha las byung ba'i ser po rgyas byed lha dgu'i rjes 8 gnang*/ ser po rgyas byed lha lnga'i rjes 9 gnang*/ g.yon zhal dmar po las byung ba'i dmar po dbang sdud kyi rjes 10 gnang*/ rtsa zhal mthing nag las byung ba'i nag po dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rjes 11 gnang*/ dngos sgrub rgya mtsho'i yi ge dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag len dbri snon la brten nas shi sa bstan pa'i rjes 12 gnang*/ 'di la gdong gsum dang brtsegs zhal mar grags/ yig cha dngos gzhi dang tshar chen gyi zin tho la brten nas gnad dbab kyi mgon po nang gshin rje ltar sgrub pa'i rjes 13 gnang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zin tho ltar khyung zhal can nam dmag dpon mgon po'i rjes 14 gnang*/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i zin tho la brten nas gsung ngag gser chos bcu gsum/

mgon po che chung sogs slob bshad gdams pa phal cher rdzogs mthar bstan pa gtad pa'i tshul gyis bram ze nag po'i sngags gtad kyi rjes 15 gnang dang bcas pa rnams legs par nos so// gnyis pa snyan brgyud gsum pa gdams pa dngos la/ man ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i nyams khrid/ rgyab brten lung dang phyag bzhes man ngag bcas pa gnyis/ dang po la/ thog mar rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub srung 'khor rgyun gyi nyams len mar grags pa'i yi ge dang zhal shes la brten cing sngon 'gro gsang khrid nas kha bskangs te phyi nang gi srung 'khor 'chi med sgrub pa zhar byung bzlog pa dang bcas pa'i phyi'i nyams khrid zab mo/ 'di byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che bas bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis dgung lo brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs pa'ang man ngag 'di nyid kyi che ba yin par snang ngo*// rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i khrid yig zung 'jug rnam par rol pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i bshan pa chen po la gzhi byas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan pas mdzad pa'i lhan thabs yig chung zin bris zhal shes dang bcas pas brgyan nas/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems/ yig brgya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i khrid/ dngos gzhi 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i bsnyen pa/ 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi sgrub pa/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i las sbyor/ zhar byung ma 'grub na spogs chog gi ngo sprod dang bcas te sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum tshang ba'i nyams khrid la brten nas rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i gnad kyi gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa mdud rnams grol nas cir snang bde ba chen po'i rol par shar te/ tshe 'di nyid la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byed nus pa'i gsang khrid kyi nyams khrid zab mo dang zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rang gi snying dbus su 'bral med du bzhugs nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba'i dmar khrid dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud kho na la chig brgyud du bzhugs pa'i nyams khrid zab mo smin rgyas su legs par nos so// gnyis pa rgyab brten lung dang phyag bzhes man ngag bcas pa la/

dkar chag gis zin pa'i skor dang*/ ma zin pa'i skor te gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i chos skor gyi dkar chag gsung rgyun pad+ma'i srad bur brgyus pa'i zab don nor bu'i do shal/ de las gsungs pa'i chos sde'i rnam grangs paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa nas brgyud pa/ shrī paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa/ kha sar+pā ṇi'i ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku sa li chen mo nas brgyud pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang dpal mgon po nag po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams 'jigs byed pa'i// nag po de la phyag 'tshal nas// zhes yod pa'i mgon po gdong brnyan can nam las sbyor gyi mgon por grags pa glang gdong phyag drug pa'i sgrub (glo)(nyi)()thabs kyi rtsa ba'i rgya gzhung slob dpon klu sgrub snying pos mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang lo tsā ba gnyan dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ rgya gzhung gi 'grel pa dri med don gsal dge bshes dge ba rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis nyang brag dga' ldan dgon du mdzad pa/ 'gor tā ra na mo/ dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs kyi man ngag (glo)paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa'i zhal gdams mthar thug pa ni zhes yod pa'i gtso 'khor lnga'i mngon rtogs chung ngu bla ma gong mas mdzad pa der rtogs par bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rang skad cig gis hūm̐ mthing nag tu gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes yod pa'i gtor chog gi yi ge gong mas mdzad pa de wī sid+dhi zhes nyer gcig gam gsum la sogs pas dbul lo'i mtha' can/ 'gor tshangs pa ser po ngang pa zhon zhes yod pa'i 'khor mang gi mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma gong mas mdzad pa bka' nyan gsung bstod las byed tshul du bsam gyi mtha' can/

las sbyor gyi gsal byed las kyi sham bu brgyad (glo)(nyi)()pa zhes pa bsad pa'i las/ mdze gtong ba/ rabs gcod pa/ zhing la lo mi skye ba/ rims nad gtong ba/ grong khyer dkrugs pa/ grong bshig pa/ bskrad pa/ smyo bar byed pa/ 'di gnyis lhag pa 'dra zhig byung kyang gong gi khongs su bsdus sam snyam/ dbang du byed pa rnams gnyan los mdzad pa/ 'di yan gyis glang gdong ma'i skor rdzogs nas/ zhar byung 'gor dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// dpal ldan mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i// gser gyi spu gri'i lag len 'dri// zhes yod pa'i dpal mgon khyung zhal can nam dmag dpon mgon po'i sgrub thabs lag len gzhung nas dril nas btus/ sngags 'chang bstan pa bsrung bar shog gi mtha' can rnams so// gnyis pa shrī paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa la/ 'gor rgya skad dang zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa'i rtsa ba'i sgrub (e)(sgau)(glo)(nyi)thabs rdzong pod na'ang yod/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i bdag mdun mgon po zhal khra can nam sgrub dus kyi mgon por grags shing*/ deng sang yongs grags sgrub dus kyi mgon po zhal g.yas g.yon mthing nag tu byed pa'i yi ge 'ga' zhig 'dug kyang tshar lugs la sgrub dus kyang zhal khra can du mdzad pa gzhung 'di'i gnad 'gag gtso bor ston par snang*/ rgya gzhung rtsom pa po rang nyid dang gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ gzhung chung 'di la phrin las rnam bzhi bye brag tu sgrub tshul gyi gnad 'gag kyang zur tsam bstan 'dug cing*/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes gsang sgrub gsal byed snying thig gi skabs rgya gzhung las bshad tshul gyi rtsa ba'ang gzhung 'di la brten pa yin no// 'gor rgya gar gyi yul du chu bo gaṅgā dang nyi ma phyed dang gnyis tsam yod pa'i grong chung ngu'i 'gram zhig na zhes yod pa'i gnyan los mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mjal tshul gyi lo rgyus nyung ngu dang sbrel ba'i (glo)sgrub thabs

rdzong pod na'ang yod/ kyi rim pa bsnyen pa dang las sbyor ston pa zla ba gcig gis las rnams 'grub bo ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas gnyan la'o'i mtha' can rnams so/ phal cher snyan brgyud kyi zhal shes la rag las zhes dkar chag na snang bas yi ge 'di las mang ba zhig thog ma nas med tshod du 'dug gsum pa kha sar+pā ṇi'i ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku sa li chen mo las brgyud pa la/ zab cing rgya che ba phyi'i sgrub skor/ rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa gsang ba'am nang gi man ngag snying nang gi khrag lta bu khyad par gyi man ngag dang gsum/ dang po la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun pa lo rgyus kyi yi ge nus ldan du bya ba rjes gnang gi yi ge rtsa bar gyur pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge gsal byed du gyur pa lhan thabs sam yan lag gi yi ge 'phral du nye bar mkho ba gtor chog dang bskang ba bstod bskul gyi yi ge dang lnga/ dang po la/ 'gor na mo gu ru/ man ngag 'di'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge sa chen gyis mdzad pa bon po pho mo 'dres pa lnga bcu tsam chos skyong gi nus pas bsad zer ro'i mtha' can/ 'di'i nang du kha'u par rje btsun sa skya pas zhus zer ba ltar na tshig gcig gnyis slar bsnan pa 'dra'o// 'gor brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' srung 'di'i lo rgyus ni bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus (nyi)kyi yi ge rgyas pa 'phags pas mdzad pa mnga' bdag kyang de'u grong blon po la la yang shi skad kyi mtha' can zhar byung bla brgyud dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa nus ldan du bya ba rjes gnang gi yi ge la/ 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ nag po chen po'i lung sbyin pa ni 'byor na tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rting la bya (sgo)zhes yod pa'i nag po chen po'i rjes gnang gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa gdams pa'o'i mtha' can/

rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor bla ma dang tā ra la na mo/ nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang la gsum ste zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge kha'u pas mdzad pa smon lam gdab bo zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor na mo gu ru/ dbang thob cing dam tshig ma nyams pas 'di'i rjes gnang dang bka' lung thob cing zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge sa chen gyis mdzad pa smon lam gdab bkra shis bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor tā ra la na mo/ 'di'i rjes gnang la don gsum ste sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes so zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang (e)(sgo)(glo)gsal rdzong pod na mchan mi 'dug ba don du gnyer ba 'gas yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa/ 'gor oṃ swa sti/ srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan nag po che// zhes yod pa'i rjes gnang shin tu rgyas pa nag po 'gro shes (nyi)zhes pa dpang por nag po chen po bzhugs pa 'di rang gi bla mas rjes su gnang nas bkas bskul zhing grogs mched dam pa'i gsung gi ngor rje btsun pa'i yi ge'i steng du 'phags pa'i phyag len dang zhang khu dbon las brgyud de bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bzhes ltar yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis klu'i dgon par mdzad pa/ des slob mas bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i 'gor/ dpal zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa la zhes yod pa'i gri snying bla rdo srog 'khor phyag mtshan rnams kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams so// gsum pa rtsa bar gyur pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge la/ kun gyi rtsa ba ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa'i sgrub (sgo)(glo)(nyi)thabs mchan bshad du grags pa'i yi ge rdzong chung pa'i der 'gro ba'i lam du an dha mu shar bcug la sba'o yan las mi 'dug cing gong dkar ba'i glegs bam na de'i 'jug tu grong khyer bskyod pa dang sngags thung bris pa cig dang yang dngos gzhi dkyus dang mthun pa la ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta'i lugs kyi lo rgyus sgrub thabs gnyan gyis mdzad pa de'i lo rgyus chu bo gaṅgā zhes sogs yod pa mjug na btags nas bsres pa zhig kyang snang ngo*//

gzhung de la brten nas bsnyen sgrub zhar byung mnan pa dang bcas pa 'gor ma hā kā (sgo)(glo)la'i man ngag la bsnyen sgrub gnyis las zhes yod rdzong pod na'ang yod/ pa gnyan lo'i u pa de sha'o'i mtha' can/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i chos skyong gi gnad kyi yig chung (sgo)(glo)zhes pa bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ bsad pa/ las sbyor dang bcas pa zhal gyi gdams rdzong pod na'ang yod/ pa 'di mi la ma spel rnam smin che'o gsung ba'i mtha' can/ mgon po sgrub dus kyi las rdzong pod na'ang yod/ khrigs (sgo)bla ma kha'u pa chen pos mdzad pa snying phyung rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod ces brjod do'i mtha' can/ 'gor ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha u pa de sha zhes yod pa'i mgon po sgrub (e)(sgo)(glo)dus kyi las khrigs gsal rdzong pod na'ang yod/ byed sa chen gyis mdzad pa de'i snying ga bsnun par bya'o'i mtha' can/ kha'u pas mdzad pa'i las khrigs kyi gsal (e)(sgo)(pha)byed 'gor bla ma mgon po nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po sgrub dus kyi las khrigs la gsum zhes yod pa'i yi rdzong pod na las khrigs chen po zhes pa las mdzad pa mi gsal/ ge sngags 'chang gzungs pas mdzad pa dgra na ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa'i nges par 'grub bo sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa bsnyen cing sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i bsnyen sgrub (e)(nyi)las gsum gyi sgrub thabs nag po 'gro shes dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi yig chung mi spel gsang bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na 'di gzungs pa'i nag 'gros su ngos bzung*/ rnam gsum lag leg gsal byed zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i lag len dmar khrid mthong chog bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsung bzhin bsod nams grags pa dpal bzang pos yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba'i blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba la brten nas zin bris su bkod pa/

bsnyen pa'i go rim gnad don snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i skyes phreng rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pas dad ldan slob ma'i zhal ngor sbyar ba/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor tā ra na maḥ dpal mgon tsa turmu kha'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i bzlas pa dang gegs sel gyi man ngag snyan brgyud gser chos mthar thug des mdzad pa'i 'gor/ bla ma mchog dang chos skyong la// lus ngag yid gsum gus btud nas zhes yod pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum spogs chog shi sa bstan pa dang bcas pa'i mngon rtogs gsal byed gnad kyi zhal gdams mthar thug snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gser chos mchog tu gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag des mdzad pa'i dpal gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma bca' thabs kyi snyan brgyud snying gi khrag thigs lta bu/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor/ bla ma yi dam bstan skyong la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// zhes yod pa'i las rab 'byams dang bsad bskrad kyi 'khor lo'i zhal gdams chig brgyud ma snying nang gi khrag lta bu/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa'i bye brag tu bsad las kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can du grags pa rno myur spu gri reg chod dang 'dra ba'i man ngag snyan brgyud mthar thug des mdzad pa'i 'gor/ bla ma mchog dang lha mchog la// zhes yod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bltab cing sba ba sogs mnan pa'i man ngag mthar 'don thabs dang bcas pa snyan brgyud sbas don gsal ba/ yar klungs pa'i gsung 'di rnams phyi sgrub la ltos pa'i bka' brgya dam pas mang ba la mi ston pa'i gras/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub thabs rta bdun rgyal po zhes bya ba mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ de skor gyi yig chung bzhi zhes pa pradzñā pha la'i gsung bzhin bris pa'i sa chen kun dga' snying po'i man ngag gnad brgyad pa'i ngos 'dzin dang*/

chos tshan bzhi'i skabs 'di gnyis so sor 'dre na/ ma chag pa'i gnad gnyis ston pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i srog snying gnad kyi man ngag snying dang 'dra ba mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs kyis dwags lha sgam por sbyar ba/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i mnan pa dang srog gi zhal gdams i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor chos skyong gyi rten gyi 'khor lo ni dbang po dar ma grir shi ba zhes yod pa grub pa dpal gyis yi ger bkod pa rnams so// bzhi pa gsal byed du gyur pa lhan thabs sam yan lag gi yi ge la/ spyi'i lhan thabs bye brag gi lhan thabs las phran bu'i man ngag dang gsum/ dang po la/ srog 'phrog pa/ bcing ba/ khyi ltar khrid pa/ snga phyi gnyis mi 'khren pa rtsal 'gran pa ste zhal gyi gdams (e)(sgo)(glo)pa don lnga rdzong pod na yod pa der mi spel ba'i bka' rgya yod do yan las med/ ma shākya'i dge slong gnyan gyi u pa de sha lta ba/ dam tshig mthun rdzas/ sngags/ 'khu ldog mi 'byung ba/ shi sa bstan pa ste zab pa'i gnad drug gi gdams pa mchan bu dang bcas pa ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag gnyan gyi gsung*/ de'i gsal byed gdams pa 'di la don drug ste zhes/ rdzong pod na yod pa der skad ngan tse re 'ong ngo yan las mi 'dug yod pa'i bla ma (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)gnyan gyi nye gnas dar ma seṅge la gnang ba srod thun la gtor ma med du mi rung ngo'i mtha' can/ mgon po la pha ltar bkur zhing lha mo la sring ltar dungs pa'i man rdzong pod na'ang yod/ (e)(sgo)(nyi)ngag blos khel ba ni 'go ba'i gnad yin no'i mtha' can/ khyad par gyi dam tshig (glo)yi ge shin tu gsang bar bya ba rnams yin no'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'khon nag zas su za ba'i gdams ngag (sgo)(nyi)slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'di rdzong pod na yod ngor pa'i der klu sgrub nas brgyud pa zhig 'dug pa 'di dang mi mthun/

gong dkar ba'i glegs bam du slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i kha gsal mi 'dug 'gor dpal ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo// nyams chag gam 'chi ltas byung ba'am chag che ba'i dus su gtor skyong byed par 'dod na maṇ+ḍal zhes yod pa'i nyams chag (e)(sgo)(glo)bkang ba'i yi ge bsdus rdzong pod na'ang yod/ pa bskang bshags cho ga'o'i mtha' can gnyan gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i dpal ma hā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa la nyams chag gam 'chi ltas byung ba'am chag che ba'i dus su (nyi)gtor skyong byed par 'dod na nang tu gtor ma zhes yod pa'i nyams chag bkang ba'i yi ge rgyas pa gdams ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'di'i dam tshig gso ba ni zhes yod pa'i kha'u pas mdzad pa'i dam tshig gso ba'i pad+ma (e)(sgo)(glo)kha sbyor gyi yi ge bsdus rdzong pod na'ang yod/ pa bla ma gnam kha'u pa gsung i thi'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma dam pa dang nag po gdong bzhi pa la na mo/ chos skyong 'di bsten pa na (nyi)zhes yod pa'i pad+ma kha sbyor gyi yi ge rgyas pa gnam kha'u pa'i gdams pa sa māp+ta'i mtha' can/ 'gor nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po'i gsang ba byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)gsang ba'i cho ga 'di dkar chag na mi gsal rdzong pod na yod/ 'o'i mtha' can rnams so// gnyis pa bye brag gi lhan thabs la/ sngon 'gro rten gyi skabs su 'gor tā ra na mo/ ma hā kā la'i rten bca' ba ni phyi rten du g.yag nag ces yod pa'i phyi nang (e)(sgo)(glo)gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i rten bca' ba'i yi rdzong pod na'ang yod/ ge shākya'i dge slong gnyan gyis mdzad pa'i u pa de sha su thod thod la bstan par mi bya'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor ma hā kā la'i rten bca' ba ni/ rdo nag po smug po'am zhes yod pa'i nang rten bla rdo bca' ba'i yi ge bsdus

rdzong pod na'ang yod/ pa gnyan lo'i gsung bcu bzhi la ma chag pa gong bzhin bya'o'i mtha' can/ de'i gsung 'gor rdo rje nag po chen po'i rten bca' ba ni/ byang shar ram shar lho nas zhes yod pa'i nang rten bla rdo bca' ba'i yi ge rgyas pa gtor ma'ang grub na bzang ngo*// bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba'i man ngag i thi'i mtha' can/ gsang rten gyi skabs su 'gor rten bca' thabs la gri snying 'khor lo zhes yod pa'i gtum po rang (sgo)(glo)srung gi 'khor lo 'dri tshul rten bca' thabs so'i mtha' can/ 'di gnyis gcig tu byed na ma gtogs so sor byed tshe dkar chag tu gcig mi gsal bas zhar byung yin nam snyam/ 'gor gtum rdzong pod na'ang yod/ po srung ba'i 'khor lo dang zhes yod pa'i gsal (sgo)(glo)byed gser srang bzhi phul zhes grags so'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'di'i gnad la bla ma chos rje bdag gi bla ma lags na'ang zhes yod pa'i rang (esgo)srung 'khor lo thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag dpal mgon khyod la mthol lo bshags kyi mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang bzhugs/ de'i bri yig 'gor srung 'khor la mu khyud phyi nang (sgo)gnyis zhes yod pa'i u pa de sha'o'i mtha' can/ de'i sngags byang grong khyer bskyod pa dang sngags ring gi mtshams (sgo)mtshams su 'dri lugs kyi gsal byed rdzong pod na'ang yod/ yod pa thams cad g.yas su skor du 'dri'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rten gyi 'khor lo bya bar 'dod na zhes yod pa'i rten 'khor 'dri tshul (e)(sgo)(glo)rgyas pa rnam par brgyan no dhā ra ṇi'i mtha' can/ rten gyi 'khor lo rab tu gnas pa rten 'brel gyis rten la thim par bsam mo'i mtha' can/ 'gor dharma pā la tsa turmu kha'i rten bca' ba ni zhes yod pa'i rten gyi yi ge (nyi)rgyal tsha lung mang pos mdzad pa dharme shwa ras brjed thor bris pa/

de byung dge ba sangs rgyas bsngo// zhes pa'i mtha' can/ gong dkar ba'i glegs bam na gtor ma phul bas 'grub bo yan dang mngon spyod bsad las sgrub na man so sor byas shing mdzad byang yang mi gsal/ 'gor bla ma dang dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod pa bsrung ba dang zhes yod pa'i rang (nyi)srung chen mo ling tshe nyi shu pa'i bri yig bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che nas zhang dkon mchog dpal la gnang ba nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi phyag bris las bshus so'i mtha' can/ mchod pa'i skabs su 'gor rten gyi mdun du mchod gtor dang zhes yod pa'i me tog (sgo)bzhi sbyor gyi yi ge gnyan los mdzad pa rgyud 'jam bzhi sbyor man ngag go'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i gong gi gsal byed 'gor tā ra na maḥ lung rjes su nod pa'i puṣ+pe zhes yod (sgoglo)pa'i ba ling gyi me tog rnying pa'i u pa de sha'o'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor/ mchod pa'i spos sbyor chog ni/ zhes yod pa'i mgon po'i spos sbyor gyi man (e)(glo)(nyi)ngag lus sbrid pa la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung ngo'i mtha' can/ ngor lugs la le tshan gnyis po go rim slog 'dug cing gong dkar ba'i glegs bam du'ang de ltar snang*/ gtor ma'i skabs su des mdzad pa'i 'gor bla ma gnyan lo'i zhal (glo)gdams gtor ma bsham dus zhes yod pa'i gtor ma bca' thabs kyi yi ge rgyun gyi thun mtshams so'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor yar ngo'i brgyad dang mar ngo'i brgyad la zhes (glo)yod pa'i gtor ma gtong thabs kyi yi ge yum la sngags 'og mas dbul la nang par gtong ngo'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa la na mo/ rtag gtor man ngag dam pa ni// zhes yod pa'i rtag gtor gyi man ngag tshigs bcad ma gsang zhing sba ba nyid du bya zhes pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor 'di'i mdun na lcags snod gru gsum zhes yod pa'i drag po'i gtor ma'i man ngag gsang ngo ma spel zhig gi mtha' can/

'di dkar chag na mi gsal ba gong gi 'phros yin nam snyam/ dngos gzhi bsnyen pa'i skabs su sngags byang la/ grong khyer bskyod pa/ sngags ring*/ sngags thung*/ 'khor lo'i sngags/ sbags sgrub so sor phral ba rnams kyi sngags phreng mchan bur bcas pa (sgo)(glo)sngags btu'i gzhung dang thems yig sa paṇa gyi phyag bris dang mthun par bla ma'i gsung rgyun bzhin sngags 'chang ma tis zhus dag pa/ sngags ring mchan bur bcas pa (sgo)(nyi)sngar gyi dpe rnying dag pa dang thems yig nas byung ba/ sngags ring mchan bur bcas pa paṇa chen nags rin gyis zhus dag pa de'i zhal slob puṇ+ya bi dza ya in+d+ra se nas slar yang zhus dag pa/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i mchan/ sngags byang gsum po dkar chag tu sngags byang zhes pa las so so'i gsal ka mi 'dug 'gor oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal nag po chen po'i sngags thems bstan pa la zhes yod pa'i sngags kyi thems (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)yig zhib mo 'di rnams shin tu gces pas mkhas pa gal che sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor bla ma la na mo/ sngags kyi thems yig la 'bru bya ba tsheg bar bgrang zhes yod pa'i sngags kyi thems yig gsal byed bdag chen rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa bla ma'i man ngag gi rjes su 'brang ba gal che'o'i mtha' can/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i sngags kyi (e)(sgo)(glo)(nyi)gnas las so so'i sngags dag par bzlas so'i mtha' can/ ngor lugs la shi sa bstan pa dang sbrel 'dug rdzong pod na'ang yod/ 'gor rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan he ru ka zhes yod pa'i sngags kyi thems yig dang spel tshig thor bu ba dar nag la btags te g.yab bo'i mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mgon po gdong bzhi pa'i bsnyen sgrub ces yod pa'i thun mong gi bsnyen pa'i yi ge 'phags pas mdzad pa dbang du 'dus pa rdo rje gur las gsungs so'i mtha' can/

rdzong pod na'ang yod/ des mdzad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge shog dril bka' rgya ma'i gdams pa/ 'di la gsang sgrub kyang zer/ sgrub pa'i skabs su 'gor rje btsun gyi zhal nas spyir sgrub pa mi dgos gsung zhes yod pa'i sgrub pa'i (glo)(nyi)gnad rje btsun gsung rgyun shin tu bka' dam par mdzad do'i mtha' can/ 'gor las sbyor ling ga la thun rnams zhes sdang 'bar ba'i zhes yod (e)pa'i sgrub
